title: Engineering Manager
description:
Sunday creates pocket-sized friends for the mass market. We turn idle moments into meaningful connections for millions of users worldwide.

Sunday focuses on the psychology of care, companionship, and empathy. We build accessible worlds where players don't just solve puzzles, they rescue friends. By combining mass-market accessibility with deep emotional hooks, we are defining the next era of digital entertainment.

As Engineering Manager, you will lead Sunday's engineering team of approximately ten engineers across Unity game development and SDK. The position reports to the Director of Operations and works in close partnership with Production, Product, and Growth.

The role combines people leadership with technical ownership. Your primary responsibility is to lead and develop the team and to define how engineering operates. At the same time, you remain close enough to the code to own architectural decisions, review critical work and contribute directly where this supports delivery.

Our team delivers frequent releases across a portfolio of live games. We are looking for a leader who understands the trade-offs between quality, time and budget in the context of business priorities, and who translates them into sound technical decisions and the management of the team. This includes making our delivery pace sustainable through stable releases, a well-maintained codebase and engineering practices that scale with the business. The role carries a clear mandate to shape how engineering works at Sunday.

What you will own

  • People leadership: development plans, performance conversations against clear role expectations, hiring and onboarding. You hold conversations early and directly.

Sunday Natural is one of Germany’s fastest-growing natural health brands, and our eCommerce platform is growing with it – today it serves 7 million monthly active users, runs on €400k of AWS per year, and supports a development organization of 30+ engineers. Every one of those numbers has moved sharply upward in the last few years, and all of them will keep moving.

You would be our first dedicated in-house Senior DevOps Engineer – and the two biggest engineering projects of the next two years are yours to help define and drive: bringing our entire infrastructure under Terraform, and strengthening the scalability, security and compliance posture across our cloud environments.

Your role

  • You shape the infrastructure vision. How we run, deploy, monitor and scale is yours to define, propose and defend.

As the platform grows, taking the technical direction of that group is a natural next step, and one we would actively support.

Kpler is expanding into high-value maritime verticals, with Cruise Liners and Port Operations representing two important opportunities. Both address a common market need: the lack of independent, reliable insights into actual performance, built on observed data rather than published schedules or self-reported information.

In the cruise sector, operators and analysts often rely on published itineraries rather than actual vessel movements, despite the significant fuel and carbon costs associated with fleet operations. In ports, performance data is often incomplete or self-reported, creating a need for independent benchmarking as berth-level emissions carry increasing financial implications under schemes such as the EU ETS.

As a Senior Product Manager, Cruise Liners & Port Operations, you will own both products end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to the first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build two early-stage products in parallel, leveraging Kpler’s network of more than 13,000 AIS receivers and over 10,000 mapped ports and berths.

LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).
 
 
VOTRE RÔLE
 
 
Rattaché(e) au Directeur Image, Le/la Head of Production Photos E-Commerce est responsable du pilotage global des productions photographiques  destinées à l’e-commerce et au showroom.

title: Consultant met AFAS-ambitie
description:
Ben jij klaar om organisaties slimmer, sneller en digitaler te laten werken? Als AFAS consultant binnen het team van Peopletrack vertaal jij complexe klantvragen naar slimme oplossingen in AFAS. Van het optimaliseren van HR- en payrollprocessen tot het inrichten van een strak digitaal uitdienstproces: jij zorgt dat het werkt.

Je werkt als consultant van Peopletrack voor uiteenlopende klanten in sectoren als zorg, retail, kinderopvang en logistiek, waardoor geen dag hetzelfde is. Nog geen AFAS-ervaring? Geen probleem. Via onze Peopletrack Academy leer je alles wat je nodig hebt om uit te groeien tot volwaardig AFAS consultant.

Taken

Binnen het Consultancy team ondersteun je als AFAS Expert onze vaste en nieuwe klanten in het optimaal gebruik maken van AFAS. Denk hierbij aan het implementeren en optimaliseren van verschillende bedrijfsprocessen: Dit kan de inrichting van een nieuwe functionaliteit zijn, het oplossen van incidenten in de huidige inrichting, het sparren over een nieuwe organisatiestructuur of het adviseren over (en inrichten van) een optimaal werkend (digitaal) uitdienstproces.

De branches waarin wij opereren variëren van de gezondheidszorg tot aan detailhandel en van de kinderopvang tot de logistieke sector. Je komt regelmatig bij de klanten over de vloer of hebt telefonisch of digitaal klantcontact. Je helpt de klant op weg, adviseert, spart of brengt de gevraagde kennis bij. Geen dag is dus hetzelfde!

Heb je een HR, Payroll, Finance, IT of Consultancy achtergrond en ervaring en/of interesse om met systemen te werken en procesoptimalisaties te doen? Dan ben je ook welkom om te solliciteren. Nog geen AFAS ervaring? Wij spijkeren de kennis bij die jij nodig hebt in de vorm van onze Peopletrack Academy. Afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring starten we met een intensief traject waarin je begeleid wordt door één van onze collega’s. Aan de hand van cases, presentaties en héél veel samenwerk

title: Adviseur Financiële Effecten
description:
Wil jij je analytische vaardigheden inzetten voor beter overheidsbeleid en tegelijkertijd snel groeien in een dynamische adviesomgeving? Bij Sira Consulting werk je aan maatschappelijke vraagstukken die ertoe doen. In ons kleine, hechte team combineer je onderzoek, analyse en advies om beleid en regelgeving daadwerkelijk te verbeteren.

Jouw rol bij Sira Consulting

Als adviseur help je ministeries, provincies, waterschappen en gemeenten bij het verbeteren van beleid en regelgeving. Vanaf de start ben je betrokken bij het volledige onderzoeksproces: van de eerste analyse tot het opleveren van een concreet en bruikbaar advies.

Je werkt als projectmedewerker in een projectteam en krijgt, afhankelijk van je ontwikkeling, al snel meer verantwoordelijkheid, bijvoorbeeld in het coördineren van (deel)projecten. Je schakelt veel met collega’s, opdrachtgevers en externe stakeholders en leert zo het vak van adviseur in de praktijk.

Taken

Wat je gaat doen

  • Je verdiept je snel in nieuwe beleidsthema’s en maakt complexe onderwerpen eigen
  • Je voert interviews met beleidsmakers, uitvoerders, ondernemers en andere experts
  • Je analyseert kwalitatieve en kwantitatieve onderzoeksdata
  • Je vertaalt inzichten naar heldere conclusies en praktische aanbevelingen
  • Je schrijft toegankelijke en goed onderbouwde rapportages
  • Je stemt regelmatig af met opdrachtgevers en werkt nauw samen met je projectteam
  • Je werkt vanuit ons kantoor in Utrecht en gaat af en toe op pad voor afspraken

Vereisten

Wie wij zoeken
Om in deze rol snel verantwoordelijkheid te kunnen pakken en effectief te zijn, heb je nodig:

2 – 3 jaar relevante werkervaring, bijvoorbeeld op het terrein van beleid en/of onderzoek (een promotie kan gelden als relevante werkervaring)

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met kwalitatieve en/of kwantitatieve onder

title: HR consultant
description:
Heb jij HR-ervaring en wil je graag jouw kennis en expertise inzetten, maar óók jezelf verder ontwikkelen? Zoek je afwisseling en uitdaging in jouw werkzaamheden?

De consultants van Buro Payroll ondersteunen klanten uit diverse branches tijdelijk op het gebied van HR en/of salarisadministratie. Als HR-consultant van Buro Payroll ga je aan de slag bij onze klanten en ondersteun je de HR-afdeling tijdelijk bij uiteenlopende opdrachten. Van het verwerken van mutaties, opstellen van contracten en het meedenken aan procesoptimalisaties in AFAS tot aan het adviseren over HR-specifieke vraagstukken en deelnemen aan HR-projecten.

Taken

In deze rol ben jij hét HR-gezicht voor één of meerdere klanten. Je voert niet alleen de dagelijkse HR-werkzaamheden uit, maar kijkt ook kritisch naar bestaande processen. Waar kan het slimmer, efficiënter of consistenter? Jij ziet verbeteringen, signaleert deze en vertaalt dit naar concreet HR-advies waar de opdrachtgever direct mee verder kan.

Onze klanten zijn divers: van gevestigde namen tot kleinere organisaties met grote ambities. Dat betekent dat geen opdracht hetzelfde is: elke werkomgeving, iedere casus en elk HR-vraagstuk biedt jou weer nieuwe inzichten. Zo blijft je werk dynamisch én ontwikkel je jezelf razendsnel.

Veel van onze klanten werken met AFAS. Heb je daar nog geen ervaring mee? Geen probleem! Wij zorgen dat jij precies de kennis krijgt die nodig is om vol vertrouwen aan de slag te gaan. Vanuit ons label Peopletrack zijn wij namelijk AFAS-partner, waardoor wij beschikken over voldoende opleidingsmateriaal om deze software eigen te maken!

En verder…

  • Onze accountmanagers zoeken opdrachten die aansluiten bij jouw kwaliteiten, interesses én groeipad.

  • Bij elke klant werk je samen met het lokale HR-team, zodat je nooit alleen staat in je opdracht.

  • Daarnaast heb je een hechte groep HR-collega’s bij Buro

About Nous

Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute.

We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money.

With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked.

Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent.

And it's working. We're growing more than 20x year on year, with a market-leading NPS above +80, and we manage well over half a billion pounds of household spending. About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

Fractile is building the next generation of AI computing technology, developing innovative hardware and software solutions designed to transform the performance and efficiency of AI workloads.

We're bringing together exceptional talent across semiconductor engineering, software, and AI to solve some of the most ambitious challenges in computing.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Tired of being told “that’s not your scope”?

Plenty of good analysts hit the same wall: you query the data but never build the pipelines, you’re boxed into one lane, and more scope means waiting your turn. Here, it’s the opposite.

Taptap Send moves billions of dollars a month across 6 of 7 continents. We’re probably the largest, fastest-growing money movement business you’ve never heard of. Cards, wallets, business-to-business payments, institutional payments, and new markets are all launching now, and each needs its data, reconciliations and reporting built from scratch. That’s your work.

The job

You’ll own the external reports the business can’t operate without, then automate them into reliable, reusable dbt models. From day one you’ll work with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product and Data Engineering to make sure every number is modelled correctly.

  • Own external reporting: deliver the datasets behind month-end close and regulatory reporting, on time, every cycle.

  • Automate: turn multi-day manual work into scheduled pipelines, runbooks and dbt models, so it only gets done once.

  • Get ahead of launches: build reports and reconciliations as each product and market goes live, before anyone asks.

  • Be first line for data requests: build models so people and AI agents can answer repeat questions themselves.

  • Keep data trustworthy: build tests, checks and alerts that catch reconciliation breaks and stale data before they become incidents

title: Mid Market Account Executive - French speaker
description:
About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

title: Communications, Brand & Events Lead
description:
About Orakl Oncology

Every cancer patient deserves a treatment that works for them. Today, too many never get one in time: fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs make it through clinical trials, and every failure costs patients precious time.

Orakl exists to change those odds.

We bridge biological and artificial intelligence by building large cohorts of virtual cancer patients, combining real patients' tumors with their medical histories and deep biological data. By integrating patient-derived tumor models, experimental biology and AI, we help pharmaceutical companies predict how cancer drugs will perform in patients, identify promising treatments and make better decisions earlier in drug development.

Founded in 2023 by Fanny Jaulin, PhD, Diane-Laure Pagès, PhD, and Gustave Ronteix, PhD, Orakl is a spin-out of Gustave Roussy, one of Europe's leading cancer centres, building on a decade of research. Backed by international investors, we are scaling our technology and partnerships with pharmaceutical companies worldwide.

Discover more at orakl-oncology.com

The role

We are looking for our first Communications, Brand & Events Lead to build Orakl's external presence from the ground up and establish the company as a leading voice in AI-driven cancer drug development. Your job is to make the world understand what we are building, why it matters and why Orakl is uniquely positioned to lead this transformation.

You will shape how Orakl is perceived by the pharmaceutical companies we partner with, the scientists we want to attract, the investors backing us and the broader industry

title: Senior Business Development Manager
description:
About Orakl Oncology

Every cancer patient deserves a treatment that works for them. Today, too many never get one in time: fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs make it through clinical trials and every failure costs patients years.

Orakl exists to change those odds. We bridge biological and artificial intelligence by building large cohorts of virtual cancer patients: real patients’ tumors, paired with their medical history and deep biological data. Because we can test treatments on these virtual patients at scale, we can predict, with causal evidence, how a patient will respond to a drug long before it reaches the clinic. This helps pharma companies bet on the right drugs, for the right patients, much earlier on.

We were founded in 2023 by Fanny Jaulin, PhD, Diane-Laure Pagès and Gustave Ronteix, PhD as a spin-out from Gustave Roussy, one of Europe’s leading cancer centers, and we build on 10 years of research. We are backed by top international VCs and growing fast. Discover more here on Orakl’s website.

title: Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation - Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F)
description:
Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation – Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F)

À propos de notre client

Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux.

Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE.

Le poste

Votre rôle : mettre au point de véritables méthodes d’essai. À partir d’un besoin de mesure (température, pression, déplacement, déformation, ultrasons…), vous concevez, instrumentez et validez des cellules d’essais haute température et haute pression. Vous commencez par fiabiliser une cellule existante : simplifier son montage et son démontage, puis la valider à plus haute température. Vous lancez ensuite les cellules suivantes.

Vous travaillez avec l’équipe qui conçoit aujourd’hui les équipements, et avec le bureau d’études d’un fabricant partenaire qui réalise la conception détaillée et les plans de fabrication. Environ 70-80 % conception et développement, 20-30 % laboratoire. Rattachement à la direction des opérations.

Ce que le poste n’est pas : ni dessinateur ou calculateur (le détail et les plans sont externalisés), ni management d’équipe. 

Vos missions

  • Définir le besoin, le cahier des charges et le pré-dimensionnement fonctionnel de nouvelles cellules.
  • Choisir les capteurs adaptés et les intégrer ; résoudre les enjeux d’étanchéité, de tenue en température et en pression.
  • Consulter fournisseurs et sous-traitants, suivre la fabrica

title: Strategic Account Executive (Zurich)
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a motivated and results-driven Strategic Account Executive to join our team. title: Defect Inspection Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Your Role

As a Defect Inspection Engineer/Expert, you will be responsible for ensuring the defect-free quality of semiconductor wafers using Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems and unpatterned wafer inspection.

You will detect defects such as particles, scratches, haze, and surface roughness that could impact the yield of our integrated graphene photonics process flow. Working in a cleanroom environment, you will collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams to set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve defect detection and classification.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection on materials such as bare silicon, epitaxial layers and polished wafers

  • Set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes

  • Fine-tune inspection tool and recipe parameters to improve defect-detection sensitivity, inspection quality, repeatability and overall performance

  • Analyze defect data to identify trends, root causes and potential process excursions

  • Interpret defect data and translate findings into actionable insights for process teams

  • Generate defect maps, Pareto charts and reports to communicate findings

  • Participate in Design of Experiments (DOE) to optimize inspection parameters

title: Chief Architect
description:
Chief Architect

Remote - US

Legion Technologies is building the AI-powered operating system for the hourly workforce. We are hiring a Chief Architect to serve as Legion’s most senior hands-on technical leader and to shape the technical foundation that will power the next decade of product innovation.

This is not a strategy-only or advisory role. The Chief Architect must live close to the code, go deep with engineering teams, challenge assumptions, write and review technical designs, make high-consequence architecture decisions, and help turn bold product ambitions into scalable, reliable production systems.

This person will own architecture and technical decision-making for the most complex parts of Legion’s Workforce Management platform, including AI, optimization, forecasting, scheduling, distributed systems, data platforms, real-time decisioning, enterprise scalability, security, compliance, and developer productivity.

The ideal candidate has built and scaled mission-critical software used by large enterprise customers, has deep technical credibility with senior engineers, and can operate fluidly between code-level decisions and long-term platform strategy. They are pragmatic, decisive, opinionated, and comfortable making hard tradeoffs when simplicity, scalability, reliability, or customer trust require it.

This role reports to the Head of Product, Engineering, and Support. This is an open role currently being filled on an interim basis by the CEO.

Responsibilities and Duties

Hands-On Architecture and Technical Decision-Making

Serve as Legion’s senior-most hands-on technical authority for complex architecture, system design, and platform evolution.

  • Personally dive into code, design documents, production incidents, performance bottlenecks, and implementation tradeoffs to diagnose root causes and guide technical direction.
  • Lead the hardest technical decisions across AI systems, optimization engines, distributed systems, data architecture, reliability, scalability, security, and platform modernization.
  • Write prototypes, reference implementations, architecture decision records, technical specifications, and design patterns where needed to unblock teams and establish clear direction.
  • Make high-consequence technical decisions with incomplete information, balancing correctness, simplicity, speed, scalability, reliability, cost, and long-term maintainability.
  • Challenge architectural drift, unnecessary complexity, weak abstractions, and short-term decisions that create long-term platform risk.
  • Partner directly with Staff, Principal, and senior engineering leaders in design reviews, code-level discussions, and implementation planning.

  • Strong SQL experience with a deep understanding of analytical modeling concepts

  • Hands-on experience with dbt (models, tests, docs, macros)

  • Familiarity with data engineering concepts (ELT/ETL, orchestration, version control, CI/CD)

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

About the role

Today, our SMB sales motion is dialed in. The majority of new customers find us; they visit our website, start a trial, or request a walkthrough of the platform. We’ve built a process that converts these visitors into customers at an impressive rate.

Over the past year, our product has become increasingly competitive for support teams at larger companies (100-1,000 employees), but those prospects don’t always arrive on our site ready to engage. That’s where you come in.

This is a true outbound sales role, designed for a rep with world-class prospecting skills. You’ll have the opportunity to not only craft our outbound sales motion, but lead the charge competing (and winning) new upmarket customers at a higher ACV.

Please note: For this role, we are only able to hire in the United States.

In this role, you will

  • Build and own your pipeline. We expect more than 75% of your opportunities to be self-sourced through target account campaigns, account-based targeting, referrals, events. Inbound will support you; it won't fill your calendar.

  • Run full-cycle deals. You'll land the first meeting, run tailored product demos, build compelling business cases, manage commercial negotiations and seal the deal. You own the sales motion (with support from our amazing team).

  • Build a playbook. What works for you becomes the baseline of our upmarket sales motion. You're the first person running it, and will work with GTM leadership to set our strategy for the future.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
About the role

We're looking for someone who owns delivery - not tracks it, not reports it, owns it.

You'll be responsible for a specific area: games, features, or platform work. From the first conversation about a requirement through to production - you're on the hook for the whole thing.

This isn’t a coordination-only role. We need someone with previous hands-on software engineering, DevOps, release engineering, or similar technical experience who can actively improve and automate the way software is built, tested, and released.

You set the timeline, track it, and communicate changes before people start asking questions. If there's a blocker, you've already seen it. If a release isn't ready, you say so - clearly and early.

You'll look at how work flows through your area and fix what's broken. Not just follow whatever process exists. You'll design something that actually works, iterate on it, and make it better over time.

A key part of the role will be identifying manual steps, bottlenecks, and failure points in development and release workflows, and then building practical automation to remove them. This may include improving CI/CD pipelines, automating release checks, connecting tools through APIs, and developing scripts or lightweight internal solutions.

Quality is yours too. Not QA's problem alone, not the tech lead's problem. You own release readiness: is it tested, is it documented, does anyone know the operational risk. If the answer is no, it doesn't ship.

You'll work closely with product, engineering, QA, and client-facing teams, keep them aligned, and report directly to the VP of Delivery.

What we expect from you

First 30 days

  • Understand how delivery actually works in your area - not how it should work, how it actually works

  • Map where work gets stuck, what the recurring blockers are, and who the key people are

  • Meet everyone who matters: product owners, tech leads, QA, release managers, client teams

  • Write up what you found and share it with the VP of Delivery

First 60 days

  • Take ownership of delivery tracking for your area

  • Pick the biggest workflow problem you found and start fixing it

  • Show you can catch a blocker before it causes a delay - at least twice

First 90 days

  • Own and communicate a delivery forecast that stakeholders actually trust

  • Ship at least one release with no last-minute surprises - quality gates passed, documentation done, everyone aligned

  • Present your view on how delivery should work in your area going forward

description:
We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to build the team behind our launch vehicles and propulsion systems. This is a hands-on, primarily onsite role focused on high-quality technical recruitment at pace.

You will partner closely with engineering and business leaders to attract exceptional talent across propulsion, mechanical engineering, systems engineering, electronics, software, manufacturing, operations, and corporate functions. You will be expected to move quickly without lowering the hiring bar, while delivering an outstanding candidate experience from first contact through to offer.

Working as part of a high-performing TA function capable of supporting hyper-growth while protecting and strengthening the quality and density of talent across the company.

Fluent German is essential. A key part of the role will be developing relationships with German institutions, rocketry teams, suppliers, and technical communities.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

"If I had asked people what they wanted, they would have said faster horses.” - Henry Ford

title: Stage: Optimalisatie van planningsrapportages
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Binnen onze organisatie speelt planning een belangrijke rol in het realiseren van projecten, het optimaal benutten van capaciteit en het bewaken van voortgang. Tijdens deze stage onderzoek je hoe de rapportagefunctionaliteiten van ons huidige planningspakket beter kunnen worden ingezet om de kwaliteit van besluitvorming en de betrouwbaarheid van de planning te verbeteren.

Je brengt in kaart welke rapportages en dashboards momenteel beschikbaar zijn, hoe deze worden gebruikt en waar de informatiebehoefte van verschillende gebruikersgroepen ligt. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met planners, projectmanagers, productie en management. Door interviews, analyses en praktijkonderzoek ontdek je waar kansen liggen om rapportages te verbeteren, te standaardiseren en te automatiseren.

Op basis van jouw bevindingen formuleer je concrete aanbevelingen waarmee gebruikers sneller kunnen sturen op capaciteit, productieprestaties en projectvoortgang. Je levert daarmee een directe bijdrage aan een efficiëntere planning en betere managementinformatie.


Wij vragen

  • Een HBO- of WO-opleiding in de richting van Bedrijfskunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, Informatica, Data Analytics of een vergelijkbare studie;

  • Interesse in data-analyse, rapportages, KPI's en procesverbetering;

  • Een analytische en gestructureerde werkwijze;

Wij bieden

  • Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt;

  • Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software;

title: Key Account Manager
description: Vacature Key Account Manager    Fresh Connection is een bekende naam binnen de logistieke sector. Onze klanten kennen ons vooral vanwege één ding: service. Service zit in ons DNA en dat merken klanten iedere dag opnieuw. We geloven in persoonlijk contact, snel schakelen en altijd dat stapje extra zetten.  Door onze groei zijn wij op zoek naar een enthousiaste en ondernemende Key Account Manager die samen met ons verder wil bouwen aan de toekomst van Fresh Connection.  Wil jij werken binnen een ambitieuze organisatie waar klanttevredenheid voorop staat? Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt, bouwt duurzame relaties op en zorgt ervoor dat klanten zich gehoord en geholpen voelen.  Je begrijpt wat klanten nodig hebben, denkt proactief mee over oplossingen en weet commerciële kansen om te zetten in langdurige samenwerkingen. Wat ga je doen?   ·        Bestaande key accounts beheren en verder ontwikkelen.   ·        Langdurige relaties opbouwen met klanten, leveranciers en interne stakeholders.   ·        Commerciële kansen en marktontwikkelingen signaleren en omzetten in concrete groei.   ·        Onderhandelen over prijzen, volumes, contractvoorwaarden en serviceafspraken.   ·        Offertes en commerciële afspraken opstellen, opvolgen en bewaken.   ·        Nauw samenwerken met interne afdelingen.       Wie ben jij?   ·        HBO werk- en denkniveau.  ·        Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een B2B-omgeving.  ·        Sterke communicatieve en onderhandelingsvaardigheden.  ·        Klantgericht, ondernemend en resultaatgedreven.  ·        Analytisch sterk en commercieel scherp.  ·        Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.  ·        Ervaring binnen AGF, food, logistiek of handel is een pré.      Wat bieden wij?   ·        Een uitdagende functie met veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid.  ·        Werken in een dynamische en internationale omgeving.  ·        Marktconform salaris.   ·        Laptop, telefoon.   ·        Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en doorgroeimogelijkheden.  ·        Een enthousiast team met korte lijnen en een informele sfeer.      Waarom deze functie?   Omdat jij niet alleen klanten beheert, maar echt impact maakt. Je bouwt mee aan groei, ontwikkelt strategische partnerships en bent een belangrijke schakel in het succes van onze organisatie.  Interesse?  Stuur je CV en motivatie naar hr@freshconnection.nl of neem contact op voor meer informatie met Sharon Kucharek – 00316-18832339  Word jij onze nieuwe Key Account Manager? Dan kijken we uit naar jouw sollicitatie!

title: Mobile Growth Manager - CRM (Braze)

Proficiency in mobile analytics and reporting tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, Looker, or Periscop

title: Logistics Executive
description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including

Growth Consultant (m/w/d), Account Management für 30 bis 40 B2B Tech Kunden in Berlin

Die meisten Account-Management-Jobs heißen Beratung und bestehen am Ende aus Reporting-Decks und Ticket-Pingpong. Hier ist es umgekehrt: Die Umsetzung macht das Team, du berätst.

Unser Kunde ist eine AI-first GTM Agentur aus Berlin Mitte. Seit 2024 auf über 5 Mio. EUR ARR und 30+ Leute gewachsen, mit 200+ B2B Tech Kunden, von der Mobility-App über einen Schweizer Telko-Konzern bis zum Bildungsverlag. Zuletzt kam in einem einzigen Monat über 1 Mio. EUR neuer ARR dazu.

Jeder dieser Kunden braucht jemanden, der ihn hält und ausbaut. Genau dafür ist dieser Seat da.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Building the intelligence behind Solskin

Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive?

We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow.

In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist.

What you will do

This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day.

Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better.

Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team.

Lead what comes next: With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products.

title: Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
About Papers

Papers AG is a Swiss cyber security engineering house and an incubator for our product portfolio. We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it.

Your portfolio includes:

  • Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones.

  • Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks.

As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges.

Your role

We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline.

Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking.

If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you.

title: Technisch Support Engineer
description:
Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan.

Steeds meer woningen worden verwarmd met onze warmtepompen. En dat betekent dat we ook steeds meer installaties moeten monitoren, klanten ondersteunen en technische problemen oplossen.

Daarom zoeken we een Technical Support Engineer die ons support team komt versterken.

Je helpt klanten en monteurs bij technische vragen, onderzoekt storingen en zorgt dat onze warmtepompen optimaal blijven functioneren. Tegelijkertijd kijk je verder dan het probleem van vandaag. Waarom ontstaat een storing? Hoe kunnen we die in de toekomst voorkomen? En hoe kunnen we onze support slimmer organiseren?

Je lost dus niet alleen problemen op, maar helpt ons ook om onze producten en service steeds beter te maken.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Technical Support Engineer ben je een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor technische vragen over onze warmtepompen. Je combineert technisch inzicht met klantcontact en werkt nauw samen met onze service-, product- en engineeringteams.

Je helpt klanten en monteurs bij technische problemen

  • Je analyseert storingen en zoekt uit wat er aan de hand is, bijvoorbeeld door systeemdata en instellingen te onderzoeken.

title: Financial Director
description:

Daarom zoeken we een Financial Director die onderdeel wordt van ons Management Team en de volledige verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor Finance.

Je wordt ons vierde MT-lid en werkt nauw samen met onze CEO, COO en People Director aan de verdere groei van DeWarmte.

Je begint niet vanaf nul. Onze founders hebben een sterke financiële basis neergezet, met een geïntegreerd financieel model dat zich al tijdens meerdere financieringsrondes en due diligence-trajecten heeft bewezen. Nu zoeken we iemand die daarop voortbouwt en Finance naar een volgend niveau brengt.

En daar krijg je alle ruimte voor.

Je ontwikkelt je eigen visie op de financiële organisatie, stelt een financiële roadmap op en bouwt een schaalbaar team. Je vertaalt cijfers naar betere beslissingen, daagt bestaande aannames uit en helpt ons de juiste keuzes te maken terwijl we groeien.

Als Financial Director ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor Fina

description:
Description

QuantumDiamonds is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. Our Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development owns the chain from raw quantum sensor data to the current map an engineer can act on: the statistical evaluation of the sensor signal, the simulation and training data pipelines, the reconstruction of fields and currents, with the machine learning pipeline for three-dimensional current in production today, and the validation of every map against simulation and reference measurements.

We are looking for a Data Scientist to own one question for the team: can we trust this map, and if not, where in the chain did it go wrong? Every measurement, in our lab or at a customer, gets a verdict and a reason. You build the checks that produce it, keep the catalogue of known artifacts and reference measurements behind it, and make it automatic for the routine cases so that your judgement goes to the hard ones. When a check fails, you trace it to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Our Applications engineers, who run the customer projects, rely on your verdict for what reaches the customer. A senior data scientist on the team backs you on the hard calls at the start; the aim is that you become the owner of this question.

This is a hands-on analysis role, not a research position: the data is real, the chain is in daily use, and every improvement you make shows up in the next measurement. Your background does not need to be in quantum sensing or semiconductors: if you have learned to tell signal from noise, calibration errors and artifacts in another demanding measurement system, we want to hear from you.

QuantumDiamonds is building commercial quantum sensing tools for semiconductor inspection and failure analysis. As our Quantum Sensing Engineer (NV Centers), you will join the Hardware Pre-Development Team and take technical ownership of the sensing core of our widefield Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDM).

At the heart of your role is one question: how do we get more performance out of the NV sensing system?

You will work across the complete sensing chain — from the diamond sensor and laser excitation through microwave spin control and bias magnetics to fluorescence collection and camera readout. When sensitivity, resolution, speed, or stability falls short, you will investigate the system end to end, identify the limiting mechanism, and turn your findings into measurable improvements.

title: SaaS Content Marketing manager
description:
ilert is an AI-first incident management software company helping companies respond to incidents faster and increase the availability of digital services. Our mission is to keep the world running at all times. We’ve done the hardest part already: built something people love. Now it’s time to take this to the next level and that’s where you come in.

Why this role is more than “just content”:

You’ll drive our storytelling to the next level: shaping how technical audiences and business leaders perceive AI-first incident management. That means creating guides that actually help, blog posts that spark trust, and content that educates.

Tasks

  • Own the content engine: craft and deliver a pulse-raising strategy that lifts brand awareness, powers lead gen, and helps customers master incident management.
  • Be the editor-in-chief of our story: lead the editorial calendar, tie content to launches, campaigns, and the initiatives that matter.
  • Tell technical stories that resonate: produce blog posts, deep-dive guides, and case studies finely tuned for developers, SREs, and IT leaders.
  • Collaborate with the best: work side-by-side with engineers for how-tos and deep technical chops, and partner with our CEO for thought leadership.
  • Own discoverability: shape SEO, GEO, and content distribution strategy.
  • Measure with intention: track what works, analyze engagement, and sharpen strategy with insights; not gut feelings.
  • Stay hyper-aware: monitor trends, competitive shifts, and industry moments to keep ilert ahead of the narrative curve.

description:
A partir de 45 K€ / CDD 12 mois

Notre client, Tisséo Ingénierie, conçoit et réalise les transports de demain de l’agglomération toulousaine. SPL de droit privé, il pilote, en qualité de maitre d’ouvrage délégué, les études et les travaux de projets d’envergure d’infrastructures de transport pour un territoire regroupant environ 100 communes et plus d’un million d’habitants. Ainsi, il accompagne les collectivités de l’agglomération toulousaine dans leur programme ambitieux de projets mobilité, avec notamment la création d’une 3ème ligne de métro (Ligne C : 27 km – 3,1 Md€), la Connexion avec la Ligne B, la modernisation de la ligne Aéroport Express et des Pôles d’Echanges Multimodaux (PEM).

 

Dans le cadre de la réalisation de la 3-ème ligne de métro toulousain, Tisséo Ingénierie recrute pour sa Direction infrastructure un(e) Ingénieur travaux- secteur Centre- projet métro (F/H)

 

Vous venez renforcer l’équipe d’ingénieurs en charge du pilotage des travaux de génie civil et de second œuvre du secteur centre de la ligne C (environ 17 km en souterrain et 12 stations) pour assurer le suivi de plusieurs marchés de travaux à différentes phase d’avancement (lot de génie civil en phase de clôture, divers lots de second œuvre en cours de démarrage ou réalisation sur 4 stations).

title: Elektronik-Ingenieur
description:
About pplwise
pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics
Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots.

About the role
This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.

Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind.

The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end: requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in prod

description:
About pplwise
pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics
Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots.

About the role
This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.

Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind.

The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end: requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in prod

title: Senior FP&A Manager (f/m/d)
description:

  • Partner with business stakeholders to assess functional performance, weigh risks and opportunities, and shape initiatives that move key metrics

  • Build and maintain financial models for target setting, budgeting, long-term planning and rolling forecasts, and run the planning processes with stakeholders across the company

title: Robot Learning Engineer
description:
Why this role is exciting

Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz, Knuspr.de, Kifli.hu, Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro, choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows.

We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match.

We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job.

You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them.

description:

title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

title: Head of Technology (m/w/d)

We find your position.

ISA Telematics baut Systeme, die Menschen, Fahrzeuge und Güter im Blick behalten, wenn es darauf ankommt: Notruf, Ortung, Alarmierung.

Das Besondere daran ist der Umfang. Die ganze Kette läuft durch eine Hand, von der Firmware auf dem Gerät über Funkprotokoll und Server bis zur Leitstelle. Kein Modul, kein Ausschnitt: das komplette System.

Und die Probleme sind echt. GPS, das im Stahlbau aussteigt. Mobilfunk, der abbricht, wenn er gebraucht wird. Geräte, die jahrelang im Feld stehen und trotzdem aktualisierbar bleiben müssen. Ein Alarm, der nicht meistens ankommt, sondern immer.

Unsere Kunden: Industrie, Energieversorger, Bahn und Logistik, Kliniken, Polizei- und Sicherheitsorganisationen im DACH-Raum. Das Produkt ist eingeführt, zertifiziert und profitabel, du baust also mit echten Nutzern und laufenden Umsätzen im Rücken.

Nach vorn ist viel Platz: weitere Branchen, neue Produkte auf der bestehenden Plattform, internationale Märkte, ein stärkeres App-Geschäft. Was zuerst gebaut wird, entscheidest du mit, gemeinsam mit einem erfahrenen Entwickler, der das System seit Jahren betreut.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

  • Volle Verantwortung für Produkt und Technik: Architektur, Roadmap, Code
  • Rund zwölf Monate übergibt dir der Entwickler das System persönlich, anschließend leitest du den Bereich Product & Technology
  • Du entscheidest, was bleibt, was modernisiert wird und was neu entsteht
  • Neue Produkte und Anwendungsfälle auf der bestehenden Plattform mitgestalten
  • Kundenprojekte von der Aufwandsschätzung bis zum Go-live, inklusive Geräte- und Ortungsanbindung (TCP/UDP, XML)
  • Normkonforme Weiterentwicklung (DGUV, DIN VDE V 0825, CE) und Störungsanalyse im laufenden Betrieb

Qualifikation

Das bringst Du mit

  • Java: drei Jahre professionelle Entwicklung
  • SQL

description:
Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest in einem Team, das das gesamte Tooling-Ökosystem verantwortet, mit dem unsere Jungheinrich Robotics Lösungen über ihren gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg implementiert, betrieben, unterstützt und kontinuierlich verbessert werden. Von der Inbetriebnahme eines Fahrzeugs vor Ort bis hin zur Ferndiagnose von Problemen einer gesamten Flotte stellst du gemeinsam mit deinem Team sicher, dass unsere Robotiksysteme über alle Robotikprodukte und zukünftigen Fahrzeuggenerationen hinweg effizient und skalierbar ausgeliefert, betrieben und unterstützt werden können.

Du arbeitest dabei in drei zentralen Bereichen:

  • Du entwickelst unser Onsite Tooling weiter und ermöglichst damit eine effiziente Implementierung, Inbetriebnahme und Durchführung von Serviceaktivitäten über unser HMI und unseren Environment Editor.
  • Du entwickelst unser Remote Tooling als Teil unserer Robotics Cloud weiter und ermöglichst damit Diagnose, Flottenmanagement, Monitoring und Support aus der Ferne.
  • Du gestaltest unsere Remote-Access-Lösungen und stellst einen sicheren und skalierbaren Zugriff auf unsere Robotiksysteme sicher, wann immer dieser erforderlich ist.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Product Manager für Robotics Tooling zusammen. Während der Product Manager den Fokus stärker auf das Was und Warum legt, ergänzt du diese Perspektive um das Wie und Wann.

  • Du gestaltest ein skalierbares Tooling-Ökosystem, das über verschiedene Roboterfamilien, Kundeninstallationen und Supportorganisationen hinweg eingesetzt werden kann
  • Du führst und entwickelst ein Team aus internen und externen Software Engineers und schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem sich Mitarbeitende weiterentwickeln, erfolgreich arbeite

title: Account Executive - Mid-market
description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

title: Chief Science Officer
description:
Chief Science Officer @ Sereact 🦾

Chief Science Officer (m/f/d) · Zurich or Stuttgart, Boston possible · Reports to the CEO · Full-time

Who we are

Sereact builds the robot brain for physical work. Cortex, our vision-language-action foundation model, is hardware-agnostic: the same model runs single-arm and dual-arm systems, mobile manipulators and humanoids that pick, sort and handle returns in live production across Europe and the US. Customers include Zalando, IKEA, BMW, Rohlik and DHL.

Founded in 2021 in Stuttgart, with an R&D hub in Zurich and a US office in Boston. We have raised more than $145 million, most recently a $116 million Series B led by Headline, with Zalando as a strategic investor. We work in small, senior teams with a flat structure; execution counts more than titles.

Why this role, why now

Our robots produce data no lab can stage. Our fleet has recorded more than 500 million manipulation interactions in live warehouse operations; Cortex 2.0 was trained on a curated 10 million of them and added a world model that plans before it acts (arXiv 2604.20246). Cortex 2.5 learns a new task from a few demonstrations instead of a training run. Deployments are growing from single robots to fleets, and the research team is growing with them.

We now want one scientific leader who owns the research behind Cortex end to end and turns what our fleet experiences every day into the next step change in what robots can do.

The Real-World Learning Loop is your system

Over the next nine minutes,   Powers of Ten   traveled out toward distant galaxies and back into the microscopic world inside a human hand. An enormous subject became a journey you could follow, built around a simple change in perspective. Images, language, movement, and sound brought the idea to life together.

You’ll originate ideas yourself and stay closely involved as they become finished work.

Whatever your starting discipline, you’ll bring deep experience in film-led storytelling. 
  You’ll lead Brand Narrative in close creative partnership with your peers leading Brand Design and Writing.  Together, you’ll shape concepts, language, and visual expression from the beginning, bringing distinct perspectives and shared ownership to the work. You’ll contribute strong ideas of your own, invite others to challenge and improve them, and build on theirs. This is a role for someone who enjoys making work together, not developing ideas in isolation and handing them off. 
 You’ll also shape what Brand Narrative becomes. That means building its culture, developing its people, and establishing ways of working that make the entire studio more creatively ambitious. The opportunity is to make great work while building a team that can keep making it.

 In your first year, your focus will be roughly  70% leading creative development for our highest-priority launches and campaigns, and 30% building the Brand Narrative function.

Partner with Product Marketing and Brand Marketing on the brief, then turn the agreed audience, opportunity, and product proof into original creative concepts. title: 3D Data Operator (w/m/d) | 3D Scans to Digital Twins of Real Factories
description:
Transforming factory scans into digital reality

At RIIICO, we're reimagining how factories adapt to change. Our AI-powered software makes complex production environments editable, interactive, and collaborative, turning manufacturing planning into something anyone can engage with, not just the experts.

We’re looking for a 3D Data Operator to help power the foundation of our digital factory experiences. No point cloud experience needed, just an eye for detail and curiosity about 3D.

In this role, you'll work at the intersection of 3D reality and AI, transforming raw point cloud data into accurate digital twins of real-world production environments. From data preparation to model generation and delivery, you'll help ensure quality, consistency, and continuous improvement across our data pipeline.

Your daily work

  • Process 3D scan data (point clouds) and transform it into usable digital factory models using our internal tools and workflows.

  • Run basic pipeline commands for data preparation and AI processing.

  • Configure and verify model outputs to ensure quality, consistency, and usability for downstream applications (e.g., Nvidia Omniverse, Siemens Plant Simulation and others).

  • Collaborate with AI-assisted tools to validate and correct automated results.

  • Flag and troubleshoot anomalies or edge cases in raw or processed data, and document issues clearly (e.g., as Git issues).

  • Track and report your weekly processing output.

  • Continuously improve workflows and documentation based on team feedback and real-world challenges.

What we are looking for

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to reliably handle repetitive tasks with care.

  • Self-motivated and dependable: you take responsibility and get things done.

title: AI-Enabled Governance Associate (f/m/x)
description:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

As our AI-Enabled Governance Associate, you will help strengthen how lemon.markets runs and improves governance processes across third-party management, partner oversight, and operational controls in a regulated environment.

This role starts with a strong focus on third-party-related governance, including external providers, partners, and intra-group relationships. Over time, the scope can evolve further toward governance excellence, KPI/SLA monitoring, control effectiveness, and AI-supported process improvement.

QuantumDiamonds is building the world's first commercial quantum sensing tools for chip failure analysis. Our Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDm) images magnetic fields with micrometer resolution, and that capability could matter far beyond semiconductors. As our Technical Business Development Intern for Emerging Verticals in the Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development, you help us find out where.

description:
About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

How we work

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:

  1. Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.
  2. Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.
  3. Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.
  4. Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.
  5. Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.
  6. Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.
  7. Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.
  8. Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Shiftbase is building the self-driving assistant for shift-based businesses across Europe. Our customers range from independent restaurants in Amsterdam to multi-location retailers in München, and they spend hours every week on scheduling, time tracking, payroll prep, and HR admin. We want to take that work off their plate and eventually do it for them.

Underneath that product vision sits a data challenge. Insight, automation, and AI all depend on data people can trust, and the foundation for it doesn't exist yet.

You will build the foundation that fixes this.

What you'll do

  • Architect the warehouse. Design and own our BigQuery and Dataform warehouse from the ground up. Build a layered, well-modeled foundation, medallion staging through marts, not only the models that sit on top. Ask every day whether the whole company can trust and reuse it.

  • Make the data flow reliably. Build ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads, orchestration, and retries, so pipelines run on time without anyone watching them. Ship monitored pipelines that hold up in production.

  • Take the transform layer. Own the Dataform model-building and transform layer, taking full responsibility for the transformation layer and freeing up capacity for semantic modeling and business definitions

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
About Shiftbase

We build workforce software that helps people get work done. More than 10,000 companies use our platform every month to plan shifts and track time, with less admin in the way.

We work from our Zoetermeer office with over 80 people and we grow every year. The culture is open and informal. You can push back on an idea regardless of title, and we change how we work when someone makes the case in retro.

About the role

You build frontend features that customers use the day you release them. You sit in a product team with backend, QA, design and product, and you take a feature from a rough product idea to a screen a planner can use without a manual.

Your time is a balance between working on features, bugs and resolving technical debt.

Claude Code is how our engineers write software. Everyone here uses it daily, and whole features now go out with an agent doing most of the coding. You still own what you merge, so you read the diff, you know why it works, and you can defend it in review. The interesting part of the job is deciding what to hand to an agent, what to write yourself, and what context the agent needs to get it right the first time.

You ask what a planner is trying to do before you read what the ticket says. You automate the parts of your own process that don't need a human.

Year one, in order

First, ship. Deliver features in scheduling and time tracking. Start small, then take one full feature from the product conversation through to release.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
About Plane

Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together.

 

Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship.

 

Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules.

 

Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work.
