title: Senior Performance Creative Strategist (gn) @ Female Health Consumer Startup, London
description:
About DITTO

DITTO is a science-led brand redefining menstrual health. As a fast-growing, VC-backed business, we're scaling a new standard in menstrual wellbeing — empowering anyone with cycle symptoms to understand, support and optimise their health every day, not just during their period. Developed by female scientists and powered by biotechnology, the Cycle Supplement is backed by over 100 clinical trials and validated in its own clinical trial.

Beyond the capsule, DITTO is building a movement — combining credible science, thoughtful design, and inclusive storytelling to change how menstrual health is perceived and supported. As we grow, performance creative will be central to how we convert attention into action.

About the role

You will sit at the intersection of data and creativity — turning science into content that stops the scroll and drives sales. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You will define what makes a potential customer stop, engage, and convert — and then build the systems to do it at scale.

You are not just briefing others. You are embedded in the work from the first concept through to post-production feedback and the next iteration. If you are equally energised by diving into data and dreaming up ideas, this role was built for you.

Performance creative strategy

  • Own creative strategy across Meta, TikTok and YouTube with clear KPIs across ROAS, conversion and scalable growth.

  • Develop creative frameworks that harness DITTO's scientific credibility to build trust and drive purchase decisions.

  • Analyse performance data to surface winning signals, identify trends and shape the next generation of assets.

  • Build and own a structured testing roadmap — challenging creative hypotheses, running experiments and scaling what works.

General Data is the infrastructure for licensing proprietary data: The platform runs the whole deal from request to delivery, with privacy checks, rights evidence and contracts built in. The vision is to become the system of record between AI and the world’s private data, the data that has never been published but that the next generation of AI depends on. On one side are enterprises, AI labs and robotics teams that need real-world data, and on the other are companies whose operations generate it. General Data is the data infrastructure for the modern economy, connecting every party so that data can be licensed safely, transparently and at scale.

AI has absorbed the public internet, and its next gains will come from private, real-world data, yet today these deals still run on email, WhatsApp and brokers, with no visibility into what was checked, who holds the rights, or whether personal data was removed. title: Test Engineer
description:
Analyseren, (functioneel) testen, debuggen… Waar houd jij je als test engineer bij ons eigenlijk niet mee bezig!?

Als test engineer is iedere werkdag anders. De complexe producten die wij maken voor onze klanten, maken gebruik van proces- en functionele testers. Uitval hiervan wordt geanalyseerd en testers worden gedebugged. Dit wordt in samenwerking met ons Test Development team gedaan, die onze testers hebben ontwikkeld, gebouwd én vrijgegeven. Het grootste gedeelte van je werkdag ben je bezig met praktische en analytische werkzaamheden.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden als test engineer:

  • Testen van prototypes: in een losse testopstelling op je werkbank meten.

  • Debuggen/functioneel testen in Labview: bijvoorbeeld na uitval op de functionele tester.

  • Sustainable analyseren: uitzoeken wat er is gebeurd, waarom is dit gebeurd en hoe we dit in de toekomst kunnen voorkomen.

  • Reparatie van uitgevallen producten; uitval na o.a. AOI, Flying probe of functionele testers of retouren vanuit de klant.

  • Interne overleggen: bijvoorbeeld met je collega’s van de afdeling Quality, Engineering etc.

  • Technisch challengen: niet alleen bij Benchmark collega’s, maar soms ook bij de klant.

Jij zorgt in alles wat je doet voor de juiste analyses en verwerking hiervan. Hierdoor worden afwijkingen gefilterd en gesignaleerd, worden root-causes vastgesteld en opgelost en blijft het productieproces continu verbeteren.

title: wo-stage economie: Nowcasting Model voor BBP

Dan is deze stage in nowcasting en econometrie precies wat je zoekt.

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Bij het ramen van de kwartaalcijfers van het bbp (economische groei) gebruiken we voor een aantal bedrijfstakken momenteel een relatief eenvoudige methode: de ontwikkeling van het aantal banen dient als benadering voor de economische activiteit. Dit gebeurt omdat directe en tijdige broninformatie ontbreekt. Een belangrijk gevolg hiervan is dat we de eerste ramingen later vaak moeten bijstellen wanneer er meer volledige data beschikbaar komt bij de definitieve raming (ongeveer anderhalf jaar later).

Het is aan jou om deze methodiek te verbeteren.

Je gaat een geavanceerder model ontwikkelen waarmee we de economische activiteit van deze bedrijfstakken kort na afloop van de verslagperiode nauwkeuriger kunnen inschatten. Dit wordt ook wel “nowcasting” genoemd. Het doel is om dichter bij de uiteindelijke realisatie te zitten en daarmee het aantal en de omvang van latere bijstellingen te verkleinen.

Op zoek naar een statistiekstage?
Analyseer bij het CBS weegmethoden en non-respons met R en draag bij aan betere statistieken voor Nederland.

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Het CBS trekt steekproeven onder de Nederlandse bevolking om diverse statistieken te maken. Hierbij is sprake van selectieve non-respons. Om voor deze non-respons te corrigeren, voeren we een zogenaamde weging uit, waarbij personen een gewicht krijgen op basis van hun onder- of oververtegenwoordiging in de respons. Personen met achtergrondkenmerken die ondervertegenwoordigd zijn in de respons, krijgen dan een groter gewicht dan personen met achtergrondkenmerken die oververtegenwoordigd zijn. Zie bijvoorbeeld [1] voor algemene informatie over wegen.

Bij het uitvoeren van een weging zijn er diverse zaken om rekening mee te houden. Zo kan niet voor alle achtergrondkenmerken worden gecorrigeerd voor scheefheid, omdat de gewichten dan te extreem zouden worden. Daarnaast is het vaak verstandig om überhaupt niet voor te veel achtergrondkenmerken te corrigeren, omdat dit een negatieve invloed heeft op de marges van de schattingen voor de doelvariabelen van een onderzoek. Ook is er een relatie met de doelvariabelen in het onderzoek: op het moment dat er een samenhang is tussen een achtergrondkenmerk en de doelvariabelen van een onderzoek, is het wenselijk om wél voor dat achtergrondkenmerk te corrigeren als dat kenmerk scheef in de respons zit. description:
About Cellsor

Cameras digitized vision. Microphones digitized sound. Smell is the one major sense we still can't capture, measure or transmit reliably. Cellsor is building the sensor that changes that.

We replicate the mammalian olfactory epithelium outside the body – living olfactory tissue on microelectrode arrays – and read it out with machine learning. The result is a sensor that detects chemicals the way a nose does, with the breadth and sensitivity that conventional gas sensors lack. Applications span flavor and fragrance, defense and security, medical diagnostics, food quality and industrial monitoring.

We are a VC-backed Tufts University spin-out with a working proof of principle and paid industry pilots, with teams in Boston (biology) and Munich (engineering).

About the role

As our first engineer in Munich, you develop the instrument that keeps our living sensor tissue alive and samples the air it analyzes. You take it from today's lab setup to a field-ready prototype at a customer site within 18 months.

What you will do:

  • Define the instrument architecture, then build prototypes across mechanics, fluidics and housing

  • Develop automated media exchange that keeps cells viable for weeks to months

  • Build the air path: sampling, filtration and controlled delivery of odorants to the sensor

  • Integrate sensors, pumps and controllers for monitoring and automation

  • Test and iterate with our Boston biology team<

About the Venture

AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.

Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around.

We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task.

Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.

The role brings together applied LLM engineering and solid backend engineering in TypeScript. Training or fine-tuning foundation models is not part of the job.

What you’ll do

  • Technical responsibility for the team, including architecture decisions and code reviews

  • Technical guidance for the team and point of contact for non-technical colleagues

  • Take over and maintain the existing LLM pipelines: review the current architecture, identify failure modes, prioritise fixes, and refactor and extend the systems without disrupting production

  • Own the RAG systems from end to end: document ingestion and parsing, chunking, indexing, hybrid retrieval (BM25 and vector), query rewriting, reranking and grounded generation with citations

title: Sales Account Executive - Cybersecurity
description:
Passionate about Cybersecurity, open-source or network effect products? Interested in Sales?

Join CrowdSec to build a safer internet for everyone.

What we do

We aim to deter opportunistic and organized cybercrime through an Internet-scale, real-time security network. This network is powered by hundreds of thousands of servers sharing the aggression they block with our open-source software. By coupling this local behavior analysis and sharing its findings within our community, we create a real-time map of IP addresses used by cybercriminals, a large-scale reputation system, and a Crowd-Sourced Cyber Threat Intelligence of unprecedented magnitude that will counter the vast majority of technical hacks.

Who We Are

CrowdSec is a human-sized team of cybersecurity experts. Most of the team has worked remotely since day 1. The CrowdSec solution is used in 180+ countries, it is a well-known, unique, collaborative, open-source security solution that protects hundreds thousands of users. We are animated by a mission: making the Internet a safer place, all together.

Role

As an Account Executive (AE), you will work with the Sales team to help them scale, create new opportunities, interact with them, convert them to Leads, and take the accounts to signature. This will be done in collaboration with the BDRs, presales, Marketing, and Support teams to ensure the most pleasant customer journey.


Must-have

  • A track record of success in selling Cybersecurity software solutions

  • A pre-existing customer/contact base to work on to kickstart your tenure

  • Knowledges of fundamental cybersecurity mechanism

title: ML Platform Engineer
description:
About us

Bleu Robotics is an AI company developing universal AI software for the deployment of advanced robots , humanoids, mobile manipulators, and industrial arms, in real factories. The convergence of humanoid robotics and modern AI is one of the most significant technical opportunities of the decade, and most of the work today still happens in research settings. We are building the software layer required to bring it into operational use.

We have a strong ambition to become the next Microsoft to run on every industrial humanoid. We have closed our pre-seed round with Top-tier fund to deploy our robot in Tier 1 manufacturing facilities.

We are looking for deeply passionate scientists who can help us push the frontier and build a major lab in physical AI.

Our vision

To enable a robot to learn a new industrial task from a few demonstrations and operate autonomously, with under one hour between the start of the demonstration and the start of deployment.

This objective shapes our roadmap and every technical decision we make.

THE ROLE

We are hiring an ML Platform Engineer to put our robot learning stack in the cloud and own the full stack. The platform will let customers run our learning pipelines on their own data as a hosted service; its exact scope will evolve with the product.

You will be the first engineer at Bleu Robotics with cloud expertise. The scope covers infrastructure, training and inference services, the web front end, security, and cost. The choice of cloud provider and web framework is open; you will make it with the team.

The role is based in Paris and is on-site.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Web + Infrastructure)
description:
Searoutes makes the emissions data that shippers use to run and reduce their
logistics. It is an operational problem before it is an environmental one, and
in our hands it is mostly an engineering one.

We are hiring a senior engineer who works across our web frontend and our
infrastructure — the same two codebases, in the same week. Someone who ships a
product screen on Monday, changes an identity-provider flow on Wednesday, and
considers those the same job.

We are looking for a broad profile rather than a specialist. The next year is
mostly platform work with a user-facing edge — user management, API gateway
management, payments, SEO, and a great deal of compliance, GDPR and ISO 27001.

If you are passionate about the environment, proactive and pragmatic in getting
things done, and love to work in a complex but fascinating industry where you
learn every day — then this is the place for you.

The work in front of us

Some of the items on our tech roadmap for the coming year. Bets are picked a
cycle at a time and shared out, so you would take the ones that suit you and
grow into the rest.

  • Product and marketing UI in React — multi-brand, WCAG AA, strong on
    technical SEO, fast enough to hold a performance budget.
  • User management and identity — Keycloak realms, organisation hierarchies,
    partner brokering, and the entitlement model in the app.
  • API gateway work in APISIX — routes, plugins and auth policy as code.
  • Payments and billing.
  • ISO 27001 and GDPR — access control, change management, audit logging,
    observability and alerting, consent and retention.
  • The infrastructure underneath — Pulumi in TypeScri

title: Data Engineer | Randstad
description:
Wil jij als Data Engineer werken aan uitdagende data-oplossingen bij verschillende toonaangevende organisaties, zonder de onzekerheid van losse opdrachten? Bij ITIS Projects kom je vast in dienst en werk je aan interessante dataprojecten bij opdrachtgevers in de Randstad. Zo combineer je de afwisseling van consultancy en detachering met de zekerheid, begeleiding en ontwikkelmogelijkheden van een vaste werkgever.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt met moderne cloud- en datatechnologie en krijgt de ruimte om jezelf verder te specialiseren. Samen kijken we bovendien welke opdrachten passen bij jouw ervaring, ambities en technische interesses.

Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van schaalbare dataplatformen en data-oplossingen.

  • Integreren van verschillende databronnen in betrouwbare datamodellen.

  • Automatiseren en orkestreren van dataprocessen.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Web + Infrastructure)
description:
Searoutes makes the emissions data that shippers use to run and reduce their
logistics. It is an operational problem before it is an environmental one, and
in our hands it is mostly an engineering one.

We are hiring a senior engineer who works across our web frontend and our
infrastructure — the same two codebases, in the same week. Someone who ships a
product screen on Monday, changes an identity-provider flow on Wednesday, and
considers those the same job.

We are looking for a broad profile rather than a specialist. The next year is
mostly platform work with a user-facing edge — user management, API gateway
management, payments, SEO, and a great deal of compliance, GDPR and ISO 27001.

If you are passionate about the environment, proactive and pragmatic in getting
things done, and love to work in a complex but fascinating industry where you
learn every day — then this is the place for you.

The work in front of us

Some of the items on our tech roadmap for the coming year. Bets are picked a
cycle at a time and shared out, so you would take the ones that suit you and
grow into the rest.

  • Product and marketing UI in React — multi-brand, WCAG AA, strong on
    technical SEO, fast enough to hold a performance budget.
  • User management and identity — Keycloak realms, organisation hierarchies,
    partner brokering, and the entitlement model in the app.
  • API gateway work in APISIX — routes, plugins and auth policy as code.
  • Payments and billing.
  • ISO 27001 and GDPR — access control, change management, audit logging,
    observability and alerting, consent and retention.
  • The infrastructure underneath — Pulumi in TypeScri

title: Engineering Manager
description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.

The Role

You'll be a player-coach engineering leader with a spike in technical strategy, you'll own engineering delivery for your team end-to-end - from developing exceptional engineers to solving some of our most difficult engineering problems & setting technical direction

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. Advocatuur

title: Senior Marketing Specialist
description:
Senior Marketing Manager

Location: Europe, Amsterdam preferred (hybrid or remote possible)
Competitive salary
Start date: as soon as possible

Let’s be blunt: Kaizo doesn’t have a real marketing engine yet.

We’ve had marketers before, but the company we are today is a different company. Over the past 18 months we’ve signed enterprise customers like Canva, Instacart, UiPath and Indeed. We’ve also rebuilt our product around a new reality: support teams now run on a mix of human agents and AI agents, and someone has to check the quality of both. Kaizo is the independent Agentic QA layer for that hybrid workforce. We work across helpdesks and Customer Service platforms, and we don’t build AI agents of our own, so we have no reason to mark our own homework.

The problem is that the market doesn’t know this yet. We’re the customer service industry’s best-kept secret.

  • The website architecture has just been rebuilt, but the content is outdated and doesn’t tell today’s story.

  • We have strong enterprise customer stories that nobody has written up.

  • Inbound is no longer enough. AI search has changed how buyers find vendors, so pipeline now has to come from outbound, partners, events and reputation.

  • We’re going to the field and starting to attend international events.

  • Sales doesn’t have all the decks, battlecards and collateral it needs.

  • Outbound has started, and it needs content behind it.


That’s where you come in.

What this role really is

We need a senior marketer who wants to build from scratch, and who sees a blank page as an opportunity, not a threat. You’ll be the one who:

  • Brings the website to life so it reflects who we are today and gets found, by people and by AI search.

title: (Senior) Toezichthouder Digital Operational Resilience (DORA) Capital Markets

Je draagt bovendien bij aan beleidsontwikkeling en kunt je expertise inzetten bij projecten binnen verschillende teams. title: Data Engineer Kapitaalmarkten
description:
Als allround Data Engineer binnen de afdeling Datagedreven Kapitaalmarkten (DAK) ontwerp, bouw en beheer je betrouwbare datapipelines en datasets voor het toezicht op de kapitaalmarkten. Daarnaast help je onze ontwikkel- en deploymentprocessen en het gebruik van Databricks verder te professionaliseren. Je ontsluit, structureert en prepareert gegevens voor data-analisten, toezichthouders en andere gebruikers. Binnen onze Azure-cloudomgeving werk je met grote hoeveelheden gestructureerde en ongestructureerde data, variërend van miljoenen tot miljarden records. De gegevens bevinden zich onder meer in Databricks, SQL-databases en Azure Storage. Je ontwikkelt herbruikbare ETL-processen en zorgt dat data vindbaar, controleerbaar en geschikt is voor analyse en toezicht. Je verbetert de ontwikkel- en deploymentprocessen met versiebeheer, geautomatiseerd testen en CI/CD in Azure DevOps. Met Declarative Automation Bundles leg je Databricks-code, configuraties en resources vast en deploy je deze gecontroleerd naar verschillende omgevingen. Hierbij werk je aan herhaalbare en beter beheersbare wijzigingen en deployments. Bij het ontwikkelen van dataoplossingen pas je de geldende kaders voor security, privacy en governance toe. Je draagt bij aan monitoring en kostenbewust gebruik van het Databricks-platform, in samenwerking met de verantwoordelijke platform-, architectuur- en securityspecialisten. Daarnaast ontwikkel je duurzame dataproducten en draag je actief bij aan kennisdeling, innovatie en standaardisatie binnen het team.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden:

  • Ontwikkelen en beheren van processen voor data-ingestie, transformatie en verwerking binnen onze Azure-cloudomgeving en op het Databricks-platform met onder andere Databricks Jobs, Azure Data Factory en PySpark/SQL.

title: Senior contractmanager IT
description:
In nauwe samenwerking met de besluitvormers van de afdeling DTI, manage je de lopende contracten, waaronder strategische. Daarbij gaat het niet alleen om het behalen van financieel resultaat, maar zeker ook om het zorgdragen dat de leverancier levert volgens contractvoorwaarden. Stakeholder- en verwachtingsmanagement is daarvoor onmisbaar en dit is dan ook jouw tweede natuur.

Als Senior Contractmanager IT heb je een scherp oog voor detail en een sterk analytisch vermogen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het toezicht op en managen van de gehele levenscyclus van contracten binnen de AFM. Daarbij zorg je ervoor dat contracten effectief worden beheerd, bewaakt en nageleefd om optimale resultaten te behalen. Je haalt energie uit overzicht creëren en het optimaliseren van processen en draagt actief bij aan de verdere professionalisering van inkoop- en contractmanagement binnen de AFM. Je richt je voornamelijk op strategische IT-contracten. Omdat een groot deel van onze IT-dienstverlening is uitbesteed en de contracten inhoudelijk en qua aansturing complex zijn, zoeken we iemand met ervaring in IT-contractmanagement en het managen van IT-leveranciers.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden:

  • Proactief managen van contracten om beoogde doelstellingen te realiseren, waaronder financiële inrichting en het oplossen van mogelijke onduidelijkheden (risicomanagement).

  • Actief bijdragen aan de implementatie van contracten binnen de organisatie.

  • Actief bijdragen aan het bepalen van de sourcingstrategie vooraf aan een aanbestedingstraject en aan de totstandkoming, verlenging en herziening van contracten.

  • Beheren van risico’s en oplossen van contractuele vraagstukken gedurende de looptijd van contracten.

  • Opstellen van heldere en tijdige contractrapportages voor management

title: Toezichthouder cybersecurity Crypto
description:
Als Toezichthouder Cybersecurity Crypto ondersteun je de AFM bij het toezicht op cryptodienstverleners die onder de Markets in Crypto Assets Regulation (MiCAR) vallen. Je beoordeelt de digitale weerbaarheid van organisaties en ziet toe op de naleving van de Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA). Daarbij combineer je kennis van wet- en regelgeving met inzicht in IT-risicobeheersing, cybersecurity en de technische werking van cryptodiensten. Je opereert in een dynamische en snel ontwikkelende markt waarin innovatie, toezicht en maatschappelijke impact samenkomen.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden:

  • Beoordelen van IT-aspecten binnen MiCAR-vergunningsaanvragen.

  • (Europese) onderzoeken naar de IT-risicobeheersing van cryptodienstverleners met een MiCAR-vergunning.

  • Analyseren van IT-risicomanagementprocessen, cybersecuritymaatregelen en operationele weerbaarheid en bepalen van benodigde vervolgacties.

  • Het analyseren van IT-incidenten, weerbaarheidstesten en uitbestedingsrisico's.

  • Contact onderhouden met interne en externe stakeholders over risico's, bevindingen en toezichtmaatregelen.

Afdeling en Team

Je maakt onderdeel uit van het team dat verantwoordelijk is voor het toezicht op operationele IT en werkt zeer nauw samen met team dat verantwoordelijk is voor het toezicht op cryptodienstverlening. Binnen deze snel ontwikkelende toezichtdomeinen werk je samen met specialisten op het gebied van toezicht, crypto , cybersecurity en wet- en regelgeving om bij te dragen aan een weerbare en integere financiële sector.

title: Senior C/C++ Low Latency Engineer
description:

This role is crucial for our organization. Our Technology team is small and therefore you get a lot of responsibilities and freedom! You are triggered by being faster than the competitors and you like to focus on quality. As you can imagine in a small team, there is a flat hierarchy and everybody is really hands-on to be the best in what we do!

We are looking for senior C/C++ Engineers with extensive knowledge and experience in building, testing, monitoring and maintaining large scale parallel applications and databases. As a C/C++ Engineer at Mathrix in the low latency environment, your focus will be on the code which facilitates the automated trades on various exchanges worldwide.

Our companies’ performance is highly dependent on the performance of our data processing pipelines. You will regularly need to appeal to all aspects of your developers’ skillset to find new and innovative ways to optimize your code. Some examples of the ‘everyday’ challenges you would encounter are and have to implement:

  • low-latency networking code for fast communication with exchanges

  • context-switch-free code

  • design and implement custom data storage structures with minimalistic footprint

  • data pipelines using a streaming paradigm

  • complex trading logic for the decision engine with the lowest possible compute time

  • reimplement existing code using advanced features of the CPU (SIMD)

To accommodate the growth of the company, we spend increasing efforts on the maintainability and manageability of our large, highly optimized and multithreaded codebases while preserving its main purpose (low latency). You will have to maneuver yourself between these worlds to get the best results.

Henry Hildebrandt ist die größte Personenmarke für Neurowissenschaften im deutschsprachigen Raum. Über eine halbe Million Menschen folgen ihm: über 250.000 auf TikTok, rund 200.000 auf Instagram und über 130.000 auf YouTube, dazu kommt ein Newsletter mit 15.000 Leser:innen. Seine Videos erreichen jeden Monat Millionen von Menschen.

Henry ist SPIEGEL-Bestsellerautor und TEDx-Speaker. Er erklärt, wie unser Gehirn lernt, sich konzentriert und motiviert bleibt, und zwar so, dass es jeder versteht und direkt im Alltag anwenden kann. description:
At Hive, we're building the defining physical AI platform of the next decade.

Industrial labor is one of the most acute bottlenecks in the global economy. Operators are expensive, hard to retain, and working in environments that are increasingly unsafe. The shortage is structural. The window to solve it is now.

Our answer is a machine-agnostic intelligence platform that lets any machine, on any site, perceive, decide, and act autonomously. One platform. Any machine. No fleet replacement.

Already live across multiple sites and customers in Europe - spanning logistics and warehousing, industrial manufacturing, and large-scale chemical production - with a US expansion underway.

The vision: one operator managing hundreds of machines simultaneously. Productive machine-hour cost dropping by 80x, and unlocks the next productivity revolution in physical work.

The mission is to make productivity limitless. Come and help us build it.

 

The Role

As Commissioning & Field Deployment Engineer, you will be responsible for the hands-on installation, integration, testing and commissioning of Hive systems, mainly at customer sites.

You will work directly on industrial machines alongside Hive Engineering and Delivery, taking systems from physical installation through technical commissioning and operational readiness.

This is a field-focused engineering role for someone comfortable combining mechanical, electrical and software-based troubleshooting in real industrial environments.

description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. In Deutschland werden an über 40 Standorten zahlreichen Spezialanalysen aus dem Bereich der humangenetischen Diagnostik, sowie der klassischen Laboratoriumsdiagnostik für Patient:innen, niedergelassene Ärzt:innen und andere medizinische Versorgungsunternehmen erbracht. Weltweit arbeiteten bereits über 44.000 Mitarbeiter:innen in 18 Ländern in Kliniken, Praxen, Blutentnahmestellen, Laboratorien und in unterstützenden Bereichen, die alle eines gemeinsam haben: die Leidenschaft gute Medizin zu machen. Du bearbeitest eingehende Anrufe mit Deinem Team und unterstützt unsere Kund:innen mit Deiner freundlichen Art. Die Einhaltung von Unternehmensrichtlinien und Qualitätsstandards stellst Du mit Deinem Team sicher.   Um Kundenanliegen zu lösen arbeitest Du mit unseren internen Abteilungen zusammen. description: Unternehmensbeschreibung    Möchtest du deine Ideen in nutzbringende und sinnvolle Technologien verwandeln? title: Front Office Manager
description: Front Office Manager – Amstel Hotel   For more than 150 years, the Amstel Hotel has stood as a symbol of elegance, excellence, and timeless hospitality. We are proud to welcome guests with warmth, authenticity, and impeccable service, qualities that start at our Front Office.  We are now looking for a confident, experienced, and service-driven Front Office Manager to lead this essential department. As a leader in Amsterdam’s most iconic hotel, you will be responsible for ensuring every arrival feels like a homecoming and every guest leaves with unforgettable memories while leading a team of passionate individuals.   Your main responsibilities:    Lead with Purpose:     Oversee the daily operations of the Front Office team to ensure seamless, five-star service at all times. Sets a positive example for guest relations.      Deliver Guest Excellence:     Uphold the highest standards of hospitality, giving VIPs, IHG One Rewards members, and repeat guests the special attention they deserve in line with LQA and brand expectations.  Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.  Performs all duties at the Front Desk and runs shifts if necessary.      Drive Results:     Monitor occupancy, room rates, and revenue performance, taking action to optimize results while ensuring compliance with credit policies and accurate reporting.  Develops new revenue and guests’ satisfaction ideas, considering the basis of permanent improvement.      Collaborate Across Departments:     Maintain clear communication with Housekeeping, Reservations, Sales, and other teams to ensure guest satisfaction and operational efficiency.      Empower and Develop Your Team:     Recruit, coach, and inspire the Front Office team, implementing training plans and conducting regular meetings to maintain excellence in service and team culture.      Support Strategy and Reporting:     Contribute to the hotel’s strategic and marketing plans, prepare the departmental budget together with the Director of Rooms and provide leadership with key performance insights.      Champion Safety and Standards:     Ensure Front Office operations meet the highest standards in safety, grooming, hygiene, and service consistency.      Who You Are     A confident and inspiring leader with a heart for hospitality and people.  A natural communicator with a positive, proactive attitude.  Detail-oriented and driven to exceed guest expectations.  Fluent in English (Dutch or additional languages are a plus).  Skilled in Opera PMS, Microsoft Office, and daily hotel operations.  Experience in a (4/5-star) hotel setting.      Why the Amstel Hotel?     Inspiring Work Environment: Join a supportive and dedicated leadership team in a hotel where history, elegance, and innovation go hand in hand.  Travel Benefits: Receive travel allowance for commutes over 5 km.  Global Hotel Discounts: Enjoy IHG employee rates at 6500+ hotels worldwide.  Local Perks: G

title: Manager, Product Support
description: MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform  for industrial and frontline teams.  More than 13,000 customers , including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.     In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining     Autodesk Operations Solutions    , the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations.  Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.   This is our first EMEA-based Customer Support management role. You will establish our European support operation while leading a distributed team of approximately seven Level 2 specialists, including our first two European specialists and existing North American team members. You will partner closely with our North American L2 manager to deliver consistent customer support, technical standards, and development opportunities across regions.  The role  You will lead a distributed Level 2 team and establish our EMEA support operation, in close partnership with the North American L2 manager.    Own triage and cross-regional handoffs, using firsthand case review and clear risk criteria to identify urgent customer issues. Ensure each handoff has a named owner, a clear next action, and an appropriate escalation path.  Build EMEA onboarding and self-paced training that enable new hires to make progress independently, supported by planned coaching and North American overlap.  Step into CSM and escalation conversations with enterprise customers, set expectations early, and bring a plan, not just an update.  Analyze case trends and DSAT to identify recurring customer problems. Bring clear evidence and recommendations to Product and Engineering, agree priorities and ownership, and track follow-through and the impact of resulting changes.  Use regular coaching and operating reviews to assess individual performance, development, retention and capacity risks, and case trends. Deliver quarterly reporting that explains the findings, actions taken, outcomes, and next priorities.  Plan regional coverage and balance queue demand, strategic-account commitments, coaching and project work. Anticipate absences and capacity constraints, and maintain clear escalation coverage during EMEA hours.    Within your first 90 days, you will understand each team member's responsibilities and development needs, establish a useful coaching rhythm, implement clear regional handoffs, and deliver an initial process improvement. title: Customer Success Manager
description: FICO (NYSE: FICO)  is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!   The Opportunity   As a Strategic Customer Success Manager at FICO, you'll be a trusted executive partner to some of our most important customers, driving transformational outcomes and sustainable growth across a portfolio of high-value accounts. This is a senior, commercially-oriented role for someone who operates naturally at the C-suite level — someone who can connect FICO's platform capabilities to a customer's most pressing strategic priorities, and turn those connections into long-term, expanding partnerships. You will own the full commercial health of your accounts, serving as the primary driver of retention, expansion, and executive alignment.  This position requires residence in Sydney or Melbourne.   What You'll Contribute     Own the Executive Relationship: Build and sustain deep, trust-based relationships with C-level and senior executive stakeholders across your accounts. You'll be a credible strategic advisor who understands your customers' business models, competitive pressures, and board-level priorities — and can position FICO's solutions accordingly.  Lead Account Strategy & Growth: Develop and execute multi-year account strategies that identify and capture expansion opportunities across FICO's platform. You'll drive net revenue retention by proactively surfacing upsell and cross-sell opportunities aligned to each customer's strategic roadmap.  Bring Deep Credit Risk Domain Expertise: You'll show up to every customer conversation as a genuine subject matter expert in credit risk, customer lifecycle management, fraud, or decisioning — not just as a relationship manager. You'll be able to engage credibly with a Chief Risk Officer or Head of Collections on the nuances of their strategy, challenge their thinking where appropriate, and connect FICO's capabilities to the outcomes that matter most to their business. Your domain knowledge will be a key differentiator in building executive trust and creating expansion opportunities that a generalist CSM would miss.  Connect Platform Capability to Business Outcomes: Leverage your understanding of credit risk and financial services to translate FICO's platform capabilities into tangible business impact — whether that's reducing credit losses, improving acquisition decisioning, optimising collections strategies, or strengthening fraud defences. You won't rely on solution consultants to bridge this gap; you'll be able to hold that conversation yourself.  Drive Transformational Value: Partner with customers to define and deliver against ambitious, measurable outcomes — moving beyond adoption metrics to demonstrate how FICO is materially impacting their business performance, risk posture, and competitive position. title: Client Relationship Manager l Private Clients
description: Client Relationship Manager – Private Clients      HI Partners is currently supporting the recruitment of an experienced  Client Relationship Manager  on behalf of an established international organisation within the financial services sector.     This opportunity is suited to professionals who enjoy developing trusted, long-term relationships with private clients and providing a high standard of ongoing service in a professional environment.      The Opportunity      You will be responsible for managing relationships with private clients, developing a strong understanding of their circumstances, objectives and priorities, and ensuring a consistently high level of engagement.     The position combines  client interaction, relationship management, communication and internal coordination  within an international financial-services environment.      Key Responsibilities      • Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with private clients  • Act as a key point of contact for ongoing client matters  • Develop a good understanding of clients' objectives and priorities  • Conduct regular client meetings and follow-up discussions  • Communicate information clearly and professionally  • Coordinate with internal teams to support client requirements  • Ensure a consistently high standard of client service and engagement  • Maintain structured and accurate records of client interactions and follow-up actions      Profile      We would be particularly interested in speaking with professionals who have:  • Experience within  financial services, private banking, wealth management, investment services or a related environment   • Strong client-facing and relationship-management experience  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills  • The ability to establish credibility and develop trusted client relationships  • A structured, professional and service-oriented approach  • Professional fluency in  English , ideally combined with an additional language  • An interest in developing their career within an international financial environment     We are open to considering professionals from a variety of financial-services backgrounds where there is strong transferable client-facing experience.      Confidential Opportunity      Due to the confidential nature of the opportunity, the identity of the organisation, its specific sector positioning and additional information regarding the opportunity will only be disclosed to candidates selected to progress through the recruitment process.      Applications and personal information will be handled in strict confidence and processed in accordance with applicable data-protection requirements.

title: Account Manager
description: About The Company   Communify is the leader in unifying the digital communication of market and client data to provide intelligent insights for investors and investment professionals. Founded on decades of maturity in delivering complex market data to some of the largest firms in financial services, Communify’s platform and Knowledge Bases allow excellent experiences - many of which you may use today. Communify’s SaaS-based product suite unifies the communication of market and client data through a library of financial apps, with solutions including Communify Markets Apps, Client Apps, Advisor Apps and AI Apps (MIND). Communify’s Knowledge Base of 4000+ unique data feeds and 500M+ page views per day also powers Communify’s advanced AI capabilities for the next generation of communication, automation and management of financial data.     As individuals, we are a diverse group, coming from varied professional backgrounds and perspectives. While some of us start with financial experience, our larger belief is that new ideas come from learning, research, analytical thinking, questioning, and translating what we know into new contexts.      Job Summary   The Account Manager collaborates closely with clients, internal stakeholders, and delivery teams to ensure alignment between client needs, business objectives, and ongoing initiatives. Bereits seit 2022 installieren wir Wärmepumpen-Komplettlösungen mit  eigenen Fachkräften . Außerdem arbeiten wir aktiv an der flächendeckenden Einführung von Smart Metern,  Elektromobilitätslösungen  und der eigenen  Stromerzeugung aus Wind- und Sonnenenergie .       Das schaffen wir allerdings nicht alleine, sondern dazu brauchen wir dich! Werde Teil unseres Teams und fordere den Status Quo heraus. Mit Energie, die gut für den Planeten ist und gut für dein Karma. 💚  Finde jetzt deinen Traumjob und werde Teil der Energierevolution von Octopus Energy Germany.     Als Customer Experience Manager (m/w/d) bist du dafür verantwortlich, die langfristige Bindung und Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden und Kundinnen zu stärken, indem du Strategien entwickelst und umsetzt, die das Kundenerlebnis kontinuierlich verbessern und die Kundenloyalität steigern.       Deine Aufgaben    Entwicklung und Implementierung neuer Strategien und Ansätze zur Steigerung der Kundenbindung und -loyalität   Erstellung und Optimierung von Kundenkommunikation (z.B. E-Mail-Marketing)   Durchführung von A/B-Tests zur Evaluierung und Verbesserung von Kundenbindungsmaßnahmen   Überwachung und Analyse von Kundenfeedback, um kontinuierlich Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und die Kundenbindung zu fördern   Quantitative Analyse und Auswertung von Kundendaten (mit Excel, SQL, BI-Tools, ggf. Python) zur Identifikation von Trends und Optimierungspotenzialen   Regelmäßige Erstellung von Reports und Dashboards zur Erfolgskontrolle und kontinuierlichen Optimierung von Retention-Maßnahmen   Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Sales und Produktteams, um eine ganzheitliche Kundenerfahrung sicherzustellen        Das bringst du mit     Mind. 2-3 Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in den Bereichen Customer Experience oder Kundenbindung - vorzugsweise in einem schnell wachsenden, dynamischen Umfeld   Ein Gespür für die richtige Sprache und ein Auge für Layout: Du hast ein gutes Sprachgefühl, setzt gerne Kundenkommunikation auf und passt diese auf Basis von Kundenfeedback kontinuierlich an   Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um komplexe Analysen und Konzepte verständlich zu präsentieren   Ausgeprägtes strategisches und analytisches Denkvermögen, um Prozesse datengetrieben zu optimieren und nachhaltiges Wachstum zu fördern   Hands-on-Mentalität: Du bist in der Lage, Daten zu analysieren, Prozesse zu gestalten und operative Themen eigenständig zu steuern   Erfahrungen in der Datenanalyse, idealerweise mit Excel / Google Sheets und/oder erste Erfahrungen mit SQL und die Bereitschaft, diese Fähigkeiten weiter auszubauen   Deutschkenntnisse

title: Service Delivery Manager
description: Functieomschrijving   Als Service Delivery Manager bij Circular IT Group ben je verantwoordelijk voor een aantal klanten en de dienstverlening die we voor hen leveren.  Je zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen, houdt overzicht en schakelt met de teams die het werk uitvoeren. Je zit er bovenop als iets niet loopt en zorgt dat het wordt opgelost.  Je bent voor klanten het vaste aanspreekpunt en weet wat er speelt. Tegelijkertijd zie je waar dingen beter kunnen en pak je dat op.   Wat ga je doen?     Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de dienstverlening richting jouw klanten.  Je bewaakt de SLA’s en volgt ze op.  Je schakelt met operations, logistiek en support.  Je signaleert knelpunten en lost ze op met de juiste teams.  Je bereidt service reviews voor en voert ze uit.  Je draagt verbeteringen aan in processen en samenwerking.  Je houdt overzicht en zorgt dat acties worden opgepakt.     Vereisten    Wie ben jij?     HBO werk- en denkniveau  Ervaring met servicemanagement of een vergelijkbare rol  Overzicht houden in een omgeving waar meerdere teams en processen samenkomen  Ervaring met SLA’s en het bewaken van serviceafspraken  Duidelijk en direct communiceren, ook als iets niet loopt zoals afgesproken  Structuur aanbrengen en zorgen dat afspraken worden nagekomen  Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de kwaliteit van dienstverlening  In staat om teams en klanten mee te krijgen in wat nodig is     Wat bieden wij?     Een salaris tussen €4.400 en €5.100 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring.  Een leaseauto of volledige reiskostenvergoeding.  Standplaats Nieuwegein met de mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken(80% kantoor - 20% vanuit huis).  Een functie voor 32 - 40 uur p.w.  Een rol waarin je direct invloed hebt op hoe nieuwe klanten starten bij Circular IT group.  Samenwerken met teams uit verschillende onderdelen van de organisatie, van sales tot operations.  Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals bijv. reisvergoeding en extra vakantiedagen.    Bij Circular IT Group geloven we dat een divers team zorgt voor betere resultaten en een fijnere werkplek. Daarom moedigen we iedereen aan om te solliciteren, ongeacht achtergrond, gender, leeftijd, overtuiging of andere eigenschappen die jou uniek maken.  Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen, maar denk je dat deze functie wel bij je past? Dan horen we nog steeds graag van je.  Wil jij deel uitmaken van een groeiend bedrijf waar je écht impact maakt?  Solliciteer nu en versterk ons team in Nieuwegein!

Package & Benefits   • Up to €80,000 base salary + more

Het borgen van een uniforme werkwijze rondom service reviews, governance, rapportages, escalaties en contractmanagement.   Het verhogen van klanttevredenheid, klantloyaliteit en contractretentie.   Het ondersteunen van commerciële groei door het actief ontwikkelen van up- en cross-sell kansen binnen bestaande klantrelaties.   Het bewaken en verbeteren van contractperformance, marges en financiële resultaten binnen de SDM-portefeuille.   Het verder ontwikkelen van Service Delivery Management als strategische discipline binnen Interstellar.   Het versterken van de samenwerking tussen Service Delivery, Operations, Sales, Finance en de specialistische teams.   Het stimuleren van een cultuur waarin klantwaarde, eigenaarschap en continue verbetering centraal staan.      Meer weten over werken bij Interstellar? title: Senior Full Stack Developer (PHP & Vue.js)
description:
At Dyflexis, we help millions of employees worldwide with our workforce management software. From the bakery around the corner to international hotel and retail chains. The software is powerful, customer questions are diverse, and no two days are the same. You'll get to know the product inside out and contribute to something that's growing rapidly in more than 20 other countries.

How do we do it? We work in a fast-paced environment with short communication lines. There are no unnecessary meetings and no politics. Our Focus? Ownership, clear communication, and getting things done together. We move quickly, learn by doing, and continuously improve how we support our customers.  We're expanding the engineering team, and we need a Senior Full Stack developer who moves across the stack and unblocks whatever's stuck, frontend or backend.


This is what you'll do
You'll join a project squad, consisting out of a Product Owner, UX designer, and fellow engineers, and move across the stack as the work demands it. One day you're deep in a Vue.js3 component, the next you're in PHP8 and MySQL sorting out the backend logic that's blocking the Frontend team. Your job isn't to pick a lane; it's to keep features moving from idea to release for over a million users.

You'll start on tickets, get to know the codebase and how we work, then move onto full projects. We build in six-week cycles, followed by two weeks to reflect and reset. Join early, question assumptions, stay close to the team throughout.

Dans le cadre de votre stage, vous serez rattaché au pôle Recherche ou Charcuterie ou Traiteur et participerez à l’étude de l’impact de la variabilité des matières premières et des procédés sur la qualité des produits finis, d’un point de vue sensoriel, économique et environnemental.

🔬 Vos missions

Vous aurez notamment pour missions de :

  • Caractériser les matières premières, produits semi-finis et produits finis sur leurs propriétés organoleptiques (couleur, texture, aspect) et leur composition chimique (humidité, protéines…), à l’aide de différents outils : colorimétrie, texturomètre, dessiccateur, NIRS et panel d’analyse sensorielle.

  • Exploiter et analyser les données recueillies afin d’étudier l’impact sensoriel, environnemental et économique des différentes opérations unitaires permettant le traitement des matières premières.

  • Identifier les opérations unitaires pouvant engendrer une variabilité de production et contribuer à la mise en place de cartes de contrôle et de documents de bonnes pratiques pour mieux maîtriser le procédé.

  • Analyser et synthétiser vos résultats, puis partager les connaissances acquises pendant votre stage auprès des experts, techniciens et responsables R&D.

Dans un souci d’accessibilité et de clarté, l’écriture inclusive n’est pas utilisée dans cette annonce. Les termes employés au masculin se réfèrent aussi bien au genre féminin que masculin.


👤 Le profil que nous recherchons

Vous êtes actuellement en Bac+4/5, en école d’ingénieur ou formation similaire, avec une spécialisation en agroalimentaire, biotechnologie, cosmétique ou chimie.

title: Special Projects Lead - Category Expansion
description:
Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo. Turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters and move fast doing it. Sounds good? Keep reading.

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first:

title: Generative Media Engineer, AI Social - US
description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity

AI Social is one of the most ambitious products we've ever shipped. An AI agent that produces on-brand Instagram carousels and reels for every Luxury Presence customer, from raw input data to finished media. It isn't LLMs writing code. It's LLMs designing, choosing the photo, voicing the script, picking the cuts, and composing the final frame.

As the Generative Media Engineer on AI Social, you own the render pipeline, the prompts and agent loops that drive it, and the visual quality of what ships. Product and content strategy partners set the direction; engineering and design peers ship alongside you. This is an unusual role at the intersection of code, design, AI, and social media. You don't fit the normal engineering mold, that's the point.

Skills and experience

  • Solid working knowledge of TypeScript and Node.js. You're comfortable shipping production code and you're ready to grow into our stack.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-driven systems. Prompts, structured outputs, tool-calling, agent loops, evals.
  • At least one shipped piece of generative media in image, video, voice, or music that someone other than you has seen and used.
  • A portfolio or body of work that demonstrates both technical depth and design sensibility.
  • Bonus: a personal creator practice somewhere. A feed, a portfolio, a side project, a YouTube channel, an Are.na. Public, ongoing, under your own name. You understand the medium because you've lived in it.
  • Formal or self-taught grounding in design, visual art, film, or motion.
  • Comfort moving between exploratory PoC work and shipped-to-customers polish, with judgment about which mode is appropriate when.

Technical fluency with AI tools

  • You're already using Claude Code, Cursor, or similar AI-assisted development tools in your daily workflow. We're a Claude Code shop and we expect you to be fluent.
  • Familiarity with MCPs and how tools like Figma, Notion, and Linear connect into AI-assisted workflows. You understand how these tools and integrations fit together and can help the team get more out of them.
  • Beyond fluency, you're a dabbler and experimenter. You try new prompts, push their limits, and share what you learn. You have opinions about where the medium is headed.

title: Kosmetiker / Skin Therapist – Laser-Haarentfernung (NiSV) (m/w/d)
description:
Aever Clinics | München | Vollzeit oder Teilzeit

Du liebst Kosmetik, moderne Behandlungstechnologien und den persönlichen Kontakt mit Kund? Du möchtest hochwertige ästhetische Behandlungen durchführen, Menschen zu einem besseren Hautgefühl verhelfen und dich fachlich weiterentwickeln? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams bei Aever Clinics in München!

Über Aever Clinics

Aever Clinics gehört zu einer wachsenden europäischen Klinikgruppe im Bereich Beauty, Hautgesundheit und ästhetische Behandlungen. Wir verbinden moderne Technologien, hochwertige Behandlungen und eine persönliche Betreuung, um unseren Kund erstklassige Ergebnisse zu ermöglichen.

Für unseren Standort in München suchen wir eine engagierte und kundenorientierte Kosmetikerin oder einen engagierten Kosmetiker, die oder der unser Team verstärkt und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen möchte.

Deine Aufgaben

Beratung und Kundenbetreuung

· Du führst professionelle Beratungsgespräche sowie Haut- und Körperanalysen durch.

· Du verstehst die Wünsche und Bedürfnisse unserer Kund und berätst sie zu geeigneten Behandlungen.

· Du erklärst Behandlungsabläufe, mögliche Ergebnisse und die richtige Nachsorge verständlich und kompetent.

About us

We're reverse-engineering the origin of life — one of the great unsolved problems in science, and one we think AI finally makes tractable. Understanding this transition, from geochemistry to biochemistry, is what will let us orchestrate molecular networks and build systems that are more capable, adaptive, and efficient.

If we succeed, the applications are vast: catalysis, green synthesis, ab initio synthetic biology, programmable matter. Understanding and harnessing these processes could let ten billion of us thrive on this planet — and let life keep evolving beyond it.

You'll engineer proteins to carry out useful chemistry, combining enzyme discovery, directed evolution, and experimental characterisation. You'll own the experimental cycle: choosing starting points, building variant libraries, developing screens, and establishing which changes improve function and why.

This is a hands-on role working closely with our computational and ML teams. You'll test designed proteins at the bench, use experimental results to guide subsequent rounds, and develop enzymes with the activity, selectivity, and stability needed for their intended application. There’s no fixed screening pipeline to inherit — you'll help decide how we build it.

What you'll do

  • Design and run protein engineering campaigns, from initial enzyme selection and library design through screening and charact

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

title: Graduate Product Manager
description:
Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth.

We're reinventing how trading and investing work by building exceptional products people love.

We move fast, set a high bar, and expect excellence from everyone on the team.

The role

We're looking for exceptional graduates to join Trading 212 as Graduate Product Managers. You'll help shape products that make investing simpler and more accessible, turning complex problems into intuitive experiences.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership from day one. You'll work with engineers, designers and teams across the business to understand client needs, decide what matters most, and take ideas from problem to launch. You'll be expected to question assumptions, get into the details and measure whether what we build actually makes things better.

This is a highly demanding role for exceptionally ambitious people who want to accelerate their career growth. It requires sustained effort, discipline and a commitment to excellence. You'll face difficult problems, high expectations and a steep learning curve.

What you'll do

  • Understand client needs through research, feedback and product data, identifying problems worth solving.

  • Turn ambiguous problems into clear proposals, user journeys and product requirements.

  • Work closely with designers and engineers to build simple, reliable and intuitive solutions.

title: Orbital Analyst
description:
Orbital Analyst

About us

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.

Our station network is expanding across Europe, South America, Africa and Australia. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.

We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, Innovate UK and the European Innovation Council.

Position Overview

You’ll be the operationally responsive member of the Astrodynamics team. You’ll take on a wide range of tasks, from producing analysis to demonstrate Foundational’s world leading capabilities, through customer facing discussions with the business development team to supporting customers with operational issues or special requirements. Expect to also be a key point of contact for our ground station teams to help ensure smooth functioning of our tracking network.

title: Head of Product - H/F
description:
Vos missions

Vos missions

Rattaché(e) à la Direction Technique, vous pilotez l'ensemble de la fonction Produit. Vous définissez la stratégie produit, arbitrez les investissements, managez l'équipe et garantissez l'alignement des moyens engagés avec les objectifs de l'entreprise.

En binôme avec le Product Lead, vous portez la vision, fixez le cadre stratégique et représentez le produit auprès de la Direction Générale.

description: Nu har du möjlighet att ta ditt nästa karriärkliv inom B2B-försäljning och bli en del av Synos Medical i Linköping! Företagets filosofi bygger på ett äkta win-win-koncept: när klinikerna lyckas, lyckas Synos. Därför erbjuder de inte bara marknadens bästa lasermaskiner, utan en helhetslösning med utbildning, affärsutveckling, marknadsföring och livstids rådgivning till kunderna.     Som Account Manager blir du en del av ett tight team på 7 personer med stark gemenskap där dina åsikter och idéer värdesätts högt. Du kliver in i en mycket viktig tillväxtroll där du steg för steg bygger upp din egen kundportfölj och i praktiken driver ditt eget "bolag i bolaget". Din roll som Account Manager innebär ansvar för hela försäljningscykeln - från första kontakt till avslutad affär samt ett långsiktigt relationsbyggande. Du kommer in till en bransch med enorm potential och du kommer arbeta aktivt med att bearbeta nya och befintliga kunder över hela Sverige. För att ge dig de bästa förutsättningarna erbjuder Synos Medical en trygg onboarding och en kontinuerlig, fördjupad säljträning som löper under dina två första år.     För att passa i rollen hos Synos tror vi att du är nyfiken, har en förmåga att jobba ihärdigt och har god affärsmässighet. Du är också kommunikativ och har ett stort resultatfokus. I rollen förekommer även en del resande till kunder runtom i landet.      Arbetsuppgifter   Rollen innebär att driva hela säljprocessen från första kontakt till avslut genom hög aktivitet, relationsbyggande och demonstrationer av Synos lasermaskiner runt om i Sverige. title: Strategic Account Manager - Tokyo
description: About Agoda   At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.       Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.     No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.    *Native/Fluent Japanese Language Level Required for this Position*    Strategic Accounts Management Team     Agoda is a travel booking platform and accommodation is at our core. As our accommodation partners are a key to our success, we work hard to ensure their success. That is why the Strategic Accounts Management (SAM) team in Agoda specializes in account management. We serve as consultants, offering strategic advice on how best to excel on Agoda’s commercial platform. We are direct contributors to what makes Agoda one of the market leaders because we understand accommodation needs and offer innovative solutions. From Bangkok to London and beyond, our team has footprints in over 50 locations around the world. With the help of industry-leading technology, we work and collaborate globally to bring together the best ideas from diverse perspectives. The SAM team invests in long-term relationships that spans borders and cultures and results in incredible value for Agoda, our partners, and our customers.        The Opportunity:        As a    Strategic Account Manager,    you will be the main contact between our accommodation partners and Agoda, with the responsibility of nurturing the relationship with our key supply partners and driving mutual growth. title: Key Account Manager - Divisione Sanità
description: Profilo ricercato:  Ricerchiamo una nuova figura per il ruolo di Key Account che si unirà al team Sales. Il profilo selezionato si specializzerà sul mercato Centro Sud Italia per la nostra suite di prodotti dedicata al settore sanitario, con particolare focus sull'ambito Casa di Cura. A stretto contatto con il Sales Manager, il nuovo profilo avrà l'opportunità di gestire e fidelizzare il portfolio di clienti esistenti, definire strategie di vendita ed individuare nuove opportunità tramite strategie di upselling e cross-selling  Il profilo ideale ha maturato almeno 2/3 anni di esperienza nella vendita di soluzioni software, preferibilmente nel settore Healthcare, e risiede nella provincia di Roma o zone limitrofe.  Skill tecniche:    Capacità di effettuare analisi di mercato  Conoscenze delle metodologie di analisi delle opportunità di vendita  Precisione nella gestione dei contratti con i clienti già acquisiti  Orientamento agli obbiettivi di vendita    Soft Skill:    Capacità di ascolto e comunicazione chiara, incisiva e precisa  Spiccate capacità relazionali  Attitudine proattiva con approccio "risk thinking"    Cosa Offriamo:     Smart Working   Flessibilità oraria   Academy interna e possibilità di crescita professionale    La retribuzione iniziale fa riferimento al livello d'inquadramento previsto per la posizione nel CCNL Commercio, con eventuali adeguamenti legati alla seniority emersa in fase di selezione  Essere parte di Onit vuol dire abbracciare valori come onestà, rispetto, equità, trasparenza, fiducia e responsabilità. Questi pilastri sono alla base delle nostre relazioni interne, creando un ambiente in cui ognuno può esercitare la propria attività in modo responsabile e flessibile. Accogliamo con entusiasmo candidati di ogni identità, convinti che la diversità sia la nostra più grande forza.  Se ti riconosci nei nostri valori, candidati ora. Ti contatteremo per un primo colloquio conoscitivo o conserveremo il tuo CV per opportunità future.  Dedichiamo tempo e cura alla valorizzazione del tuo talento, investiamo nelle tue competenze e diamo spazio alla tua voglia di metterti alla prova e fare la differenza. Se vuoi crescere insieme a ONIT verso l'obiettivo di essere il miglior partner nell'innovazione digitale, entra a far parte del nostro team!  La certificazione  Great Place to Work  conferma il nostro impegno per un ambiente lavorativo in cui il benessere e lo sviluppo delle persone sono la priorità, tanto quanto la soddisfazione dei clienti.   La registrazione sul nostro gestionale potrà esser fatta da te direttamente attraverso il pulsante "candidati" o dall'Ufficio People di Onit.   Ci teniamo a precisare che l'indice di compatibilità restituito dai test presenti in piattaforma è solo un riferimento per la valutazione; incoraggiamo tutte le persone a candidarsi alle nostre offerte di lavoro.

title: Palvelupäällikkö valtakunnalliseen asiakkuuteen Vantaalle
description: RTK-Palvelu Oy on suomalainen kiinteistöpalvelujen monialayhtiö jo 50 vuoden kokemuksella. Yhtiön 3000 ammattilaista antaa asiakkailleen päivittäin mahdollisuuden keskittyä olennaiseen. Olemme aidosti ylpeitä liiketoimintamme jalommasta tarkoituksesta, jonka myötä olemme omistajamme kautta jo vuosikymmenten ajan tukeneet lasten ja nuorten urheilua ja hyvinvointia valtakunnallisesti.   Tehtävänkuva ja odotukset Haemme valtakunnalliseen asiakkuuteen palvelupäällikköä, joka osallistuu niin asiakkuuden ohjausryhmätyöskentelyyn kuin kentän operatiiviseen toimintaan. Tuet nimetyn siivousasiakkuuden palvelutuotantoa, esihenkilöitä ja henkilöstöä eri puolilla Suomea sekä huolehdit siitä, että sovitut toimintatavat toteutuvat yhdenmukaisesti. Toimipisteesi sijaitsee pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta tarvitset tehtävässä B-luokan ajokorttia, sillä työ edellyttää säännöllistä matkustamista eri paikkakunnille.Sinulla on vahvat yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot sekä kyky rakentaa pitkäjänteisiä asiakassuhteita. Toimit luontevasti asiakkaan, oman organisaation ja eri yksiköiden kanssa ja viet sovitut asiat käytäntöön. Tehtävä edellyttää sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.Tehtävässä tarvitset kokemusta tiimien johtamisesta, henkilöstön innostamisesta ja yhteistyöstä yli organisaatiorajojen. Osaat johtaa toimintaa tavoitteellisesti sekä tukea esihenkilöitä ja henkilöstöä muuttuvissa tilanteissa. Arvostamme pitkää esihenkilökokemusta siivousalalta ja siivousalan erikoisammattitutkintoa.Tunnet siivouksen operatiivisen toiminnan, asiakkuuksien hoidon ja palvelusopimusten vaatimukset. Hallitset työssä tarvittavat järjestelmät ja hyödynnät tietoa toiminnan seurannassa, raportoinnissa, päätöksenteossa ja kehittämisessä. Varmistat palvelun laadun, sovittujen tavoitteiden toteutumisen ja arjen sujuvuuden yli yksikkörajojen. Tarvittaessa osallistut myös käytännön työhön kentällä.Kehität omaa työtäsi, palvelutuotantoa ja asiakkuutta pitkäjänteisesti yhdessä asiakkaan ja organisaation eri toimijoiden kanssa. Etsit käytännön ratkaisuja, joilla parannetaan laatua, tehokkuutta ja asiakaskokemusta. Työsi tueksi saat koko yrityksen tuen, ja työtä tehdään oikeasti yhdessä yli yksikkörajojen.   Tarjoamme Pääset osaksi motivoitunutta ja yhteistyökykyistä tiimiä, jossa arvostetaan jokaisen panosta. Yhteisömme ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava, mikä luo parhaat mahdolliset edellytykset onnistumiseesi.Pidämme huolta henkilöstömme osaamisen kehittämisestä sekä työhyvinvoinnista. Pyrimme siihen, että työntekijämme työskentelevät meillä tyytyväisinä ja pitkään.Panostamme työturvallisuuteen vahvasti – tarjoamme esimerkiksi työturvallisuuskorttikoulutuksia sitä tarvitseville, ja kehitämme turvallisia työskentelytapoja jatkuvasti.Tarjoamme monipuolisia henkilöstöetuja, jotka tukevat hyvinvointiasi sekä arkeasi – etuihimme kuuluu lounasedun lisäksi muun muassa matkailuun, hyvinvointiin ja autoiluun liittyviä etuja. Virike-edulla haluamme kannustaa sinua liikkumaan ja palautumaan
