title: Customer Success Manager
description: Are you driven, results-oriented and a team player?   With 17,000+ retailers and restaurants in over 15 countries, StoreHub is on a mission to enable everyone, big or small, to build successful businesses.     At StoreHub, we're building a dream team whereby all of your colleagues are extraordinary at what they do and are highly effective collaborators.     It is in such a team that you learn the most, perform your best work, improve the fastest, and have the most fun.      If this is a journey you’d like to embark on, keep reading!      The  Customer Success Manager (CSM)  is a commercial leader responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of live merchant accounts. This includes executing contract renewals, driving account expansion (upsells, add-ons), and building long-term customer partnerships. CSMs are trusted merchant advisors and revenue owners, ensuring that merchants achieve their goals while maximizing financial outcomes for StoreHub.     You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Onboarding, Product, and Support to resolve key merchant issues, identify opportunities, and close high-impact commercial decisions.      Responsibilities:    Own the commercial success of your assigned portfolio of merchants — including pitching and closing renewals, expansions, and add-ons.  Develop and execute win/win negotiation strategies that maximize contract value while protecting and enhancing customer trust.  Partner with the Sales and Onboarding team to fully understand and develop a clear renewal strategy for each customer.  Confidently lead commercial conversations with merchant decision-makers, including pricing, feature packaging, and contractual terms.  Maximize account growth opportunities by playing a collaborative role in the account team and helping to drive incremental revenue.  Identify customer requirements, uncover roadblocks, and proactively drive on-time renewal closures.  Collaborate with internal resources such as Finance, Product, Marketing, and Business Intelligence teams to develop comprehensive win strategies.  Provide executive visibility into renewals and solicit leadership involvement where needed to close high-risk or high-value deals.  Maintain accurate forecasts and CRM hygiene across all renewal and expansion opportunities.  Act as a CSM brand ambassador by adopting new initiatives, mentoring teammates, and delivering strategic revenue outcomes.       Required Skills/Experience:    2–3 years of success in a Sales, Account Management, or Commercial Success role with clear ownership of pitching and closing.  Strong negotiation and objection-handling skills.  Comfortable owning the full commercial lifecycle for assigned accounts — not just a relationship management role.  Excellent verbal and written communication skills with decision-makers.  Strategic mindset, process discipline, and data-driven decision making.  Strong customer management, including ability to navigate renewal resistance and product gaps

title: Key Account Manager
description: Vil du utvikle noen av Norges mest kjente merkevarer innen maling og overflatebehandling?       Scanox søker en kommersielt sterk og relasjonsorientert Key Account Manager som vil få ansvar for å utvikle salg, lønnsomhet og langsiktige samarbeid med utvalgte kjede- og grossistkunder.     I rollen får du stor påvirkning på hvordan vi utvikler kundene våre og skaper vekst sammen. Du vil arbeide både strategisk og operativt, med alt fra kundeinnsikt, forhandlinger og sortimentsutvikling til handlingsplaner, aktiviteter og oppfølging av resultater.     Scanox AS ble etablert i 1996 og er et heleid datterselskap av Jotun AS. Vi markedsfører og selger kjente merkevarer som Butinox, Trestjerner, Quick Bengalack og Tyrilin til det norske malingsmarkedet. Vi har hovedkontor i Lier, i nærheten av Drammen, og består hovedsakelig av medarbeidere innen salg og markedsføring.     Hos oss blir du en del av et kompetent og engasjert kommersielt miljø. title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
About pplwise

pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics

Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Supply Chain Manager (m/f/d) at Filics, you will build the supply chain that takes the robots into series production.

About the role

This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.
Filics robots are built from hundreds of components. Many come from a single source, and most aren’t under contract yet. Moving from prototypes to series production, one missing part can stop the whole line. Your job is to build a robust supply chain from scratch. It needs to know exactly what Filics depends on, secure those parts before they become a risk, and hold up as volumes grow, all while production is already running. You take full ownership of how every component is sourced, secured and managed.
You’ll work closely with Engineering, which owns the technical specs and qualifies suppliers and alternative components. Assembly depends on reliable supply to plan builds. Leadership sets volume commitments

title: Pricing & Deal Desk Manager (m/f/d)
description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We're hiring a Pricing & Deal Desk Manager within the Revenue Operations team. You'd take ownership of one of Moss's highest-leverage commercial functions: the pricing deal desk. It's already delivered real results, and it matters more every quarter as deal volume grows and Moss moves into bigger, more complex deals.

What makes the role unusual is that the desk already runs on AI. An agent picks up each request, pulls the deal's scoring and call history, calculates margin, and drafts a reasoned reply; you approve, correct, or overrule it. So the job is two things at once: the reviewer who decides live deals, and the person who builds & improves the AI-based deal desk agent

Your responsibilities

  • Own the day-to-day approval flow for non-standard pricing, discounts, and commercial terms, acting as the fast, consistent escalation point for reps without slowing deals down.

  • Build and evolve pricing governance, including discount rules, approval thresholds, and playbooks, converting recurring exceptions into documented policy.

  • Drive deal health across the funnel: discount discipline, price realization, deal structure, and win rate by segment, diagnosing where deals leak value and fixing it.

About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. 

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

You will be responsible for turning product development into successful market launches by ensuring every critical requirement—from supplier readiness and product documentation to inventory, ecommerce setup, training, compliance, and quality gates—is completed before go-live. Ninox ist eine Berliner Low-Code-Plattform, mit der Teams genau die Geschäftsanwendungen bauen, die sie brauchen. Rund 80 Mitarbeitende, tausende Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa, vom kleinen Team bis zum Großunternehmen. Ein Produkt, an dem Menschen wirklich hängen. Wir sind seit 12 Jahren am Markt, etabliert, wachsen und sind solide mit Wagniskapital finanziert.

Worum es geht

Du machst Outbound. Zu 100 %, und vor allem am Telefon.

Du bekommst Zielaccounts aus Branchen, die wir vorab festlegen, findest dort die Menschen, die das Problem tatsächlich haben, rufst sie an — und buchst qualifizierte Erstgespräche für unsere Account Executives. Nach dem Handover übernimmt der AE. Dein Ergebnis ist das stattgefundene, qualifizierte Gespräch, nicht der Abschluss und nicht der Kalendereintrag.

Der größte Teil unseres Geschäfts sind kleine und mittlere Unternehmen, dazu kommt ein solider Anteil Mid-Market. Innerhalb der Verticals, die für uns nachweislich funktionieren, gehen wir gelegentlich auch in größere Organisationen. Damit es keine Missverständnisse gibt: „Enterprise" heißt bei uns Unternehmen mit einigen hundert bis wenigen tausend Mitarbeitenden — nicht DAX-Konzern mit zweijährigem Beschaffungsprozess und Rahmenvertragsverhandlung.

Du arbeitest auf Deutsch und auf Englisch, jeden Tag. Deutschland und Großbritannien sind unsere Kernmärkte, weitere europäische Länder kommen situativ dazu.

Dein Umfeld, ehrlich beschrieben: Unser Vertrieb arbeitet heute Full-Funnel. Die Account Executives machen neben allem anderen rund eine Stunde Outbound pro Tag. Dazu kommt eine Kollegin bzw. ein Kollege mit ebenfalls reinem Outbound-Fokus, allerdings auf Kooperationen, Webinare und Partner. Du bist damit die erste Person bei uns, die ausschließlich und direkt auf Neukunden-Erstgespräche geht. title: Deployment Lead - ERP Solutions
description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve

title: Research Engineer, Latency & Throughput
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Research Engineer on the Latency & Throughput team, you will push the frontier of LLM inference by researching and prototyping techniques that reduce latency and increase throughput — from speculative decoding and quantization to KV compression and new attention variants. The team sits at the intersection of research and production: you will take ideas from recent literature, form hypotheses, run experiments, and ship the techniques that prove out into our serving stack.

This role sits between our inference engineers, who own the production serving stack, and our research scientists, who focus on paper-level contributions. You will be more science-focused than a pure engineer: you are expected to generate new ideas, keep up with the state of the art, and implement proof-of-concepts that bridge the gap between academic results and production impact. Some techniques you explore will be lossy or require integration into training — retraining models, tuning architectures, or training auxiliary models to improve inference.

Notre client est un acteur de l'échange de données, créé il y a plus de 30 ans, qui accompagne plusieurs centaines d'entreprises, dont de grands groupes industriels.

L'entreprise est organisée en trois pôles : l'échange de données techniques (son activité historique, dans l'industrie automobile), l'échange de données commerciales et logistiques (EDI) et une activité d'opérateur télécom (réseau, fibre optique, VPN, VoIP, firewall, cloud).

description:
Dans un contexte de croissance de l’activité EDI et de remplacement, nous recherchons un(e) Administrateur de systèmes applicatifs EDI F/H pour participer à la maintenance, à l’exploitation et à l’évolution d’une plateforme d’échanges de données utilisée par plusieurs centaines de clients.

Le poste est rattaché à l’équipe EDI, sous la responsabilité d’un manager également chef de projet.

Votre objectif

Votre rôle consistera à veiller au bon fonctionnement de la plateforme EDI, résoudre les problèmes techniques et participer à son évolution.

Vous interviendrez sur la supervision des flux EDI, la résolution des incidents et l’intégration de nouveaux clients et partenaires, tout en apportant des solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins rencontrés.

Vous participerez également à l’évolution des outils internes, notamment à travers l’intégration de nouvelles fonctionnalités liées à l’intelligence artificielle.

L’équipe que vous rejoignez

Vous intégrerez une entreprise à taille humaine, dont une équipe EDI.

Vous évoluerez au contact de profils techniques expérimentés, dans un environnement où la qualité de service, la réactivité et la proximité avec les clients occupent une place importante.

Une formation en immersion avec un chef de projet est prévue pour vous familiariser avec les standards EDI, les protocoles et les outils internes.

Ce que vous ferez concrètement

Au quotidien, vous interviendrez principalement sur :

  • Assurer l’exploitation, la supervision et la maintenance opérationnelle de la plateforme EDI.
  • Analyser et résoudre les incidents techniques signalés par les outils de supervision ou les clients.
  • Configurer et maintenir les échanges de données entre les différents systèmes informatiques.
  • Intégrer de nouveaux clients et partenaires en mettant en place les connexions et les flux EDI.
  • Intervenir sur les applications et les scripts nécessaires

UiPath’s Intelligence Document Processing drives understanding of the documents and messages on which a business runs: invoices, claims, contracts, customer emails. title: Manager Customer Service
description: Customer Service Manager Logistiek      De Customer Service-afdeling van VTS staat voor een volgende stap. We groeien hard en professionaliseren tegelijkertijd. Daarom zoeken we een manager die richting geeft, verbinding creëert en het team helpt verder te groeien. Bij ons is ieder individu van grote waarde.  Je geeft leiding aan de afdeling Customer Service Warehouse en bent de schakel tussen klanten, operatie, accountmanagement en commercie. Je begrijpt wat er speelt op de werkvloer, maar kunt net zo goed het gesprek voeren over prestaties, SLA's, contractafspraken en verbetertrajecten. Je bewaart overzicht in de dagelijkse hectiek en bent in staat de diverse belangen te honoreren.   Je bouwt aan een afdeling waar eigenaarschap, samenwerking en klantgerichtheid centraal staan. Daarbij zorg je voor structuur, duidelijke verwachtingen en een dienstverlening waar klanten op kunnen vertrouwen.      Wat krijg je ervoor terug?     Een aantrekkelijk salaris dat past bij de zwaarte, verantwoordelijkheid en impact van de functie.  Een sleutelpositie binnen een ambitieuze en groeiende organisatie.   Veel ruimte om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van VTS.  Aandacht voor vitaliteit, onder andere via Fit20 en andere fitnessmogelijkheden.  Korte lijnen, ondernemerschap en volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief in een toonaangevend familiebedrijf.        Wie ben jij?    Ruime ervaring in een leidinggevende functie in de customer service binnen de logistieke sector.   Leiderschap waarmee je mensen weet mee te nemen én aan te spreken.   Het vermogen om operationele uitdagingen te vertalen naar structurele verbeteringen.   Zakelijk inzicht om een volwaardige gesprekspartner te zijn voor klanten en interne stakeholders.       Werken bij VTS   Bij VTS geloven we dat succes wordt gebouwd door mensen die verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Mensen met vakmanschap, een ondernemende mindset en een nuchtere blik op de praktijk. We werken samen, spreken elkaar aan waar nodig en zetten altijd dat stapje extra om afspraken waar te maken.     Voor collega's, voor klanten en voor de kwaliteit waar VTS voor staat. Want waar anderen grenzen zien, zoeken wij naar mogelijkheden.      Dat is VTS. Samen zetten we iedere dag een stap extra voor collega's, klanten en de kwaliteit waar onze naam voor staat.

Je bouwt langdurige relaties op, zorgt ervoor dat klanten tevreden blijven en helpt hen om de dienstverlening optimaal te gebruiken. Je staat er daarbij niet alleen voor. Wat ga je doen? Er is een solide basis gelegd en tegelijkertijd volop ruimte om verder te ontwikkelen en te professionaliseren. Jij bepaalt waar AI het werk overneemt en waar een persoonlijk gesprek beter werkt.     Je eerste uitdaging: meedenken over de keuze tussen HubSpot en Intercom en de workflows daarna zelf bouwen. Over de inrichting van de customer journey beslis je zelf. Raakt een keuze de servicebelofte of contractvoorwaarden, dan leg je hem voor aan de Head of Customer Experience. Reporting to the CEO, you will lead day-to-day operations, oversee service delivery and develop the teams and processes needed to support growth. This is a hands-on opportunity to help build a business from an early stage while ensuring high-quality, person-centred care.      Key Responsibilities    Lead and develop Care Coordinators and operational teams, ensuring safe, reliable and efficient home care services.  Oversee care scheduling, staffing capacity, workforce allocation and continuity of care.  Develop operational procedures, quality assurance systems and service improvement initiatives.  Ensure services meet HSE contract requirements, safeguarding obligations and relevant legislation.  Build relationships with HSE representatives, healthcare professionals, clients and families.  Support recruitment, including care staff interviews, onboarding, training and retention.  Monitor budgets, staffing costs, service performance and operational KPIs.  Work with the CEO to support new contracts, service expansion and sustainable growth.       Essential Requirements    A minimum of 3 years’ management experience in home care, community care or a related health or social care setting.  QQI Level 6 in Healthcare or Social Care, or an equivalent relevant qualification.  Proven experience managing teams, service delivery and staff performance.  Strong understanding of HSE-funded home support and the Irish healthcare environment.  Experience implementing quality assurance, operational policies and safeguarding procedures.  Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills, with sound financial awareness.  A proactive, adaptable approach and confidence taking ownership in a start-up environment.  A full, valid driving licence and willingness to travel.      Experience managing multiple service areas, mobilising new services or using care scheduling systems would be an advantage.      Working Arrangements   This is an office-based role in Cork, with travel across service areas. Flexibility is required, and participation in senior on-call or escalation arrangements may be necessary.      How To Apply   To apply, submit your CV through this advert. All applications will be treated in strict confidence.  Appointment is subject to satisfactory Garda vetting, references and verification of qualifications.       Morgan McKinley is acting as an Employment Agency. References to pay rates are indicative.      By applying for this role, you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Statement, which govern your use of Morgan McKinley services.

title: Manager, Member Success
description: About Honey Homes   Honey Homes is reimagining homeownership through a membership that makes maintaining a home effortless. Our members have a dedicated handyman who proactively cares for their home year-round, helping prevent small problems from becoming expensive ones.  The Manager of Member Success owns the day-to-day performance of our Member Success organization while building the systems, tools, and processes that allow us to deliver an exceptional member experience at scale.  This is a hands-on operational leadership role. Your first responsibility is ensuring that every member message is answered, every issue is moving toward resolution, and our team consistently delivers against its service-level and quality goals. You'll manage staffing, coach teammates, monitor performance, and maintain the operational discipline required to run a high-performing support organization.  But running today's operation is only half the job. You'll also be responsible for fundamentally improving how Member Success works. You'll lead AI automation efforts, develop dashboards and tools that make our team more effective, and own strategic initiatives across a variety of operational workflows to improve member outcomes and business outcomes.  We're looking for someone who combines relentless operational execution with the ability to build systems that make the operation dramatically better. You should be equally comfortable jumping into a member escalation, managing an underperforming teammate, analyzing support data, and building a new workflow that eliminates hundreds of future conversations.  This is not a role for someone who wants to manage exclusively through delegation. You'll be close to the work, accountable for the details, and expected to continuously improve the organization you're running.  This is a hybrid role based in our Oakland headquarters (4 days/week in office).   What You'll Do     Own the daily performance of Member Success    You're accountable for ensuring that every incoming member message is answered each day and that our team consistently delivers fast, thoughtful, and accurate support. Own queue management, response times, service-level agreements, quality standards, and escalation handling. Develop the daily operating rhythms, accountability, and visibility needed to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.    Lead and develop a high-performing team    Own staffing, scheduling, hiring, coaching, and performance management for our Member Success team. Ensure we have the right coverage throughout the week, establish clear expectations, and hold teammates accountable for results. Build a culture of urgency, ownership, and continuous improvement while developing teammates who can independently solve complex member problems.    Use AI and data to transform our operations    Lead our efforts to automate member support through Sherlock, our AI-powered member assistant, and other emerging tools. Build dashboards and AI-powered workflows

title: Onboarding Specialist
description: About the role   Supermetrics helps marketing teams get their data out of the platforms they advertise on and into the tools where they report and make decisions. Most of our customers start on their own through self-serve. Some of them get stuck along the way, and today we can't reliably tell which ones are stuck and which ones are simply moving at their own pace.  This role exists to change that. You will own proactive outreach to self-serve customers during onboarding, and you will assist in delivering onboarding for our 1:1 approach. You will also help build the model that decides which customers need which kind of support. That model is being built now, so you will shape it rather than inherit it.   What you will do    Run risk-based outreach to self-serve customers. This covers one-to-many communications for most customers and one-to-one contact where a customer's potential warrants it.  Diagnose why a customer is stuck. It could be a technical blocker, a use case mismatch, or not yet understanding the value. Hand genuinely technical issues to our Implementation Architects with clear context.  Help design and refine the risk-tiering model that triggers outreach, and give input on the AI and agentic tooling that supports customers getting started.  Feed patterns you see back to Product, Support and Customer Success, so that fixable friction gets fixed rather than repeated.  Assist in the delivery of 1:1 onboarding where needed.    What you will bring    Ideally 1-2 years in a customer-facing role, such as sales development, onboarding, customer success or technical support.  Familiarity with performance marketing and the tooling used such as ad platforms, analytics tools and reporting destinations will be a huge plus!  Comfort using data to spot trends and prioritise your own time across a large book of customers.  Clear, plain written communication, since much of your outreach will reach many customers at once.  Curiosity about automation and AI, and a practical view of where a person adds more value than a sequence does.    Nice to have    Experience with a CRM system  A background at a marketing agency or in-house marketing team.  A second European language.    What success looks like in the first six months    Self-serve and Scaled customers are visible to the team every week, rather than only surfacing when they churn.  A first version of the risk-tiering model is agreed and in use.    Benefits we offer…    Competitive compensation package, including equity  Great work equipment, and home office allowance for those working in our fully remote locations  Health care benefit and leisure time insurance  Annual 1000 euros of personal learning budget  Sports and wellbeing allowance   Benefits may vary depending on location.   Hear why our team likes it here at supermetrics.com/careers/life-at-supermetrics.       Join us in putting AI to work for marketers       Supermetrics helps marketers make better decisions. title: Head of Customer Success - Loyalty and Partner Platforms (B2B)
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Build the systems, governance and account-management disciplines needed to manage these partnerships at scale.  Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team, giving them the capability and confidence to own increasingly complex customer relationships.       What we’re looking for   We’re looking for an accomplished senior relationship leader who is comfortable operating where government, technology, delivery and commercial outcomes intersect.     You’ll know how to build credibility with sophisticated stakeholders, navigate formal governance environments and manage complex contracts without allowing the relationship to become purely transactional. You’re likely to bring significant experience managing large-scale government, enterprise or institutional customers. Experience working with government departments, public-sector organisations or similarly complex institutions would be particularly valuable. We are currently looking for some incredible additions to our rapidly growing team!      Diversity   We celebrate diversity on our team; our differences are acknowledged, appreciated and respected. They must have the expertise and knowledge of both the business and platforms required to effectively manage these high-touch accounts while progressing them down the maturity path. title: People Operations Manager
description: About Us   Glitch Productions is an independent animation studio based in Australia making original, long form animated shows distributed on YouTube. Our channel has over 23 million subscribers, tens of millions of views per episode and is still growing strong. Our studio is filled with incredibly talented and passionate artists that are determined to change the way animation is produced and treated in the industry. Our biggest IP; The Amazing Digital Circus, has amassed over 350 million views on the pilot alone and we have a lot more still to come. We are growing quickly, with team members across Australia, the US, Canada and beyond.   Role Information   Glitch Productions is looking for a People Operations Manager to build the systems, data, and automation that let our People team scale with the company. This role suits someone who is highly detail oriented, comfortable owning HR technology end to end, and energised by turning manual processes into clean, reliable workflows.  Your first big priority will be leading our implementation of Deel as our global HRIS: configuring it, migrating our employee data, connecting it with payroll, Ashby and Airtable, and getting every employee and manager confidently using it.  You will report to the Global Head of People and Culture and act as the operational backbone of the People function, from HRIS ownership to employee lifecycle processes to workforce data and reporting. You will work closely with our People Partners. They focus on managers, employee relations and team needs; you make sure the systems, processes and data behind them work.  What success looks like in your first 6 months    Deel is live and adopted as our single source of truth for employee data, with clean, accurate records  Onboarding and offboarding run as consistent, largely automated workflows in every country we employ in  Team members move smoothly onto our own employing entities as we establish them in new countries  Leadership relies on regular, accurate people reporting (headcount, turnover, hiring progress) to make decisions  Our core People processes are documented so they do not rely on any one person     Your Duties Will Include    Employee Lifecycle and Experience     Own the end to end employee lifecycle processes (onboarding, transfers, promotions, off-boarding) so every employee has a consistent experience wherever they are based   Act as a first point of contact for employee queries related to systems, policies, and processes, and know when to bring in the relevant People Partner  Continuously improve the employee experience by identifying friction points and fixing them     Data & Systems     Own the implementation, configuration, and ongoing administration of Deel as our HRIS, including its LMS and headcount planning modules  Build and maintain automated workflows across HR systems and Airtable to reduce manual admin and improve data accuracy, and find recurring manual tasks to automate  Maintain workforce data

title: Senior implementation manager
description: Senior launch manager   Hybrid role based in our Dublin office, with occasional travel to our UK offices as needed   About Us   Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.  We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.  We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.  We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.  We’re now expanding into Europe, starting in Ireland. As we build Seccl Ireland, we’re looking for a senior launch manager to play a key role in turning new customer opportunities into successful launches.  Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.  The role  As senior launch manager, you’ll own the journey from the early stages of a customer conversation through to onboarding, implementation and migration.  You’ll work with fintechs, advice firms, adviser aggregators and larger enterprise businesses, getting under the skin of what they’re trying to build and helping them work out how Seccl can make it happen.  This is a hands-on, customer-facing role. You’ll lead workshops, get into the detail of technical integrations, help firms navigate our APIs and operational processes, and keep complex launches moving at pace.  You’ll also have plenty of opportunity to shape how we do things. As we build our presence in Ireland, you’ll help identify product and technical gaps, improve our onboarding approach and make each launch better than the last.  You’ll be part of our launch team, reporting to our head of strategic delivery. description: We’re Hiring:  Regional Manager, Renewals EMEA at Minitab   Location:  Hilversum, Netherlands | Office-based, with potential for hybrid working.  We’re looking for a commercially minded people leader to develop our EMEA Renewals team and help shape a growing function within Minitab. At least two years of direct people management experience within Renewals or Inside Sales.   Demonstrated ownership of revenue targets and evidence of team performance against them.   Strong financial acumen, forecasting and negotiation skills.   A commitment to coaching, developing talent and continuous learning. Experience managing subscription renewals and retention metrics would be valuable, but we also welcome Inside Sales Managers from the technology or software industry who bring transferable commercial leadership experience.  Strong English communication skills are essential. Proficiency in one or more additional languages would be advantageous . Our customers use Minitab to improve quality, eliminate waste, increase efficiency and solve important real-world problems. title: SAP - EWM - Manager - Consulting - Location OPEN
description: Location: Anywhere in Country  At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.  We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.  Our firm sets the standard for consulting services, fostering an environment that encourages career ownership at every stage. As part of our Technology Consulting sub-service line, you’ll be at the forefront of delivering transformative solutions that improve business operations. This role is part of EY’s SAP practice, which helps clients unlock business value through integrated technology platforms. We offer capabilities in Supply Chain, FICO, BPC, Data & Analytics, Customer, Tech/Arch, and SuccessFactors to drive operational efficiency and performance.   The opportunity   Our SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) professionals deliver strategic solutions to help clients transform their logistics operations, improving cost, efficiency, quality and effectiveness.  In this role, you will interact with business stakeholders to evaluate business models, processes, and operations. You will gather, understand, and analyze business requirements, translating them into technical specifications. Additionally, you will analyze newly implemented technology solutions to ensure they meet business requirements and collaborate with technical teams to design and deliver system architecture solutions.   Your Key Responsibilities   As a Manager in Technology Analysis, you will play a pivotal role in managing and delivering complex technical initiatives. You will face challenges that require innovative problem-solving and analytical skills, providing you with opportunities to grow and learn in a dynamic environment.    Lead and deliver quality SAP projects, workstreams, and ensure effective management of processes and solutions.  Track deliverable completion and project status, ensuring alignment with performance objectives.  Actively participate in client working sessions, leading workstreams from planning through execution and closure.  Participate in Explore phase design workshops.  Perform configuration of SAP EWM and other related SAP modules.  Design custom RICEF solutions and document functional specifications.  Perform testing of solutions.  Support development and delivery of training materials.  Provide on-site hypercare support to client warehouse users.  Demonstrate in-depth technical capabilities and possess strong business acumen.  Consistently delivering quality client services, monitoring progress, managing risks, and ensuring key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.  Our firm sets the standard for consulting services, fostering an environment that encourages career ownership at every stage. As part of our Technology Consulting sub-service line, you’ll be at the forefront of delivering transformative solutions that improve business operations. You’ll help clients drive growth, manage costs, and mitigate risk through the smart use of technology.  This role is part of EY’s SAP practice, which helps clients unlock business value through integrated technology platforms. We offer capabilities in Supply Chain, FICO, BPC, Data & Analytics, Customer, Tech/Arch, and SuccessFactors to drive operational efficiency and performance.   The opportunity   Our SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) professionals deliver strategic solutions to help clients transform their logistics operations, improving cost, efficiency, quality and effectiveness.  In this role, you will interact with business stakeholders to evaluate business models, processes, and operations. You will gather, understand, and analyze business requirements, translating them into technical specifications. Additionally, you will analyze newly implemented technology solutions to ensure they meet business requirements and collaborate with technical teams to design and deliver system architecture solutions.   Your Key Responsibilities   As a Manager in Technology Analysis, you will play a pivotal role in managing and delivering complex technical initiatives. You will face challenges that require innovative problem-solving and analytical skills, providing you with opportunities to grow and learn in a dynamic environment.    Lead and deliver quality SAP projects, workstreams, and ensure effective management of processes and solutions.  Track deliverable completion and project status, ensuring alignment with performance objectives.  Actively participate in client working sessions, leading workstreams from planning through execution and closure.  Participate in Explore phase design workshops.  Perform configuration of SAP EWM and other related SAP modules.  Design custom RICEF solutions and document functional specifications.  Perform testing of solutions.  Support development and delivery of training materials.  Provide on-site hypercare support to client warehouse users.  Demonstrate in-depth technical capabilities and possess strong business acumen.  Consistently delivering quality client services, monitoring progress, managing risks, and ensuring key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes. title: Manager Enterprise Solutions – SAP focus (all genders) - BCG Platinion
description: Our clients expect BCG Platinion to provide sound advice on all relevant IT issues. In particular, the migration to the SAP S/4HANA solution against the background of the planned maintenance stop in 2025 presents our customers with special challenges. The number of questions regarding "why" and "how" is increasing and is as well influenced by external factors.  In order to serve our customers even better, we would like to strengthen our SAP team. You would work together with colleagues from Platinion GmbH and/or the Boston Consulting Group on local and international customer projects. Together with our customers, you actively develop superior ERP/SAP S/4 strategies, concepts and solutions and apply your sound technical and process-related understanding. Last but not least, you enjoy your work and embody the "BCG Platinion Spirit" with your hands-on manner.   Shape the world of tomorrow     Operational management of large-scale SAP projects, leading the BCG Platinion team  Interacting with the client's leadership team (board, board, senior management) together with the BCG Platinion leadership team  Development of SAP implementation and rollout strategies and plans in complex application landscapes and client environments  Preparation and presentation of offers for major SAP projects  Taking over internal tasks as part of the BCG Platinion Leadership Team (e.g., leadership of colleagues, driving content topics, ...)  Participation in leadership meetings and practice group meetings of BCG     This Is How You Can Make a Difference     An above-average degree in computer science, business informatics, business administration or a related field  At least 6 years of relevant experience in the context of strategic ERP/SAP projects  Strong methodological background, knowledge of relevant procedures in the context of SAP rollouts such as SAP ASAP, Agile@SAP, SAP Activate  Knowledge of the corresponding supporting procedures and tools (template management, solution manager, release management/transportation, process modeling ...), incl. modern CD/CI environments (Jenkins)  Overview of SAP S/4HANA and other solutions that are relevant in the context of large transformation projects (e.g., in the context of manufacturing, PLM, MES, etc.).  Overview on modern, data-driven overall architectures, in particular the overall integration of different individual modules to end-to-end processes (Purchase-2-Pay, Order-2-Cash, Lead-2-Quote, Record-2-Report, Hire-2-Retire etc.)  Exceptional analytical and conceptual skills  Fluent in German and English (written and spoken)  Strong client and result orientation  Team spirit, communication and presentation skills as well as intellectual agility  Ability to align individuals and organizations to a common goal     How You Can Grow With Us   We guarantee constant new development incentives in an open and rewarding work environment. title: Manager IT Operations (Business Applications)
description: Herken jij je dat je bij uitstek de brug kan slaan van business naar IT en vul je dit aan met Projectmanagement vaardigheden en een achtergrond vanuit Software Ontwikkeling? Dan wacht er een mooie kans bij onze relatie Euro-Sportring. Zij staan aan de vooravond van impactvolle IT investeringen en willen dit gepaard laten gaan met het versterken van het eigen team. Daarom zijn we op zoek naar een IT management-professional die zich makkelijk beweegt in een klein bedrijf (in opzet een reisbureau / touroperator), waarbij je externe teams / leveranciers aanstuurt en innovatie nastreeft vanuit een ondernemende drijfveer.      Vacature in één oogopslag    Wil je een baan en organisatie volledig doorgronden of nieuwsgierig worden en dat gevoel verder ontdekken in een direct contactmoment? Wij geloven in dat laatste en introduceren korte vacatures.      Als Manager IT Operations, onderdeel van het MT, ben je de aanjager van innovatie en de vertaler van informatiebehoeften naar automatisering en digitale oplossingen. Euro-Sportring werkt nu twintig jaar met een op maat ontwikkelde CRM/ERP applicatie wat momenteel onvoldoende ondersteunend is in business. Daarom is de tijd nu rijp om een professional toe te voegen aan het interne team die in staat is om voorspelbaar, kritisch en slagvaardig de functionaliteiten toe te voegen en de CRM/ERP Applicatie toekomstbestendig te maken in samenwerking met de externe partner. De afgelopen maanden is er met een interim professional een lijst opgesteld waar je direct mee aan de slag kunt.      Je hebt behoefte aan:    Een interne functie binnen een no-nonsense en hands-on organisatie die enorm uitkijkt om het bedrijf te verrijken met een professional die het (business) IT gezicht wordt binnen Euro-Sportring  Diversiteit in rollen en petten. Op de korte termijn vraagt de baan vooral de rol van Technisch Projectmanager, maar in de nabije toekomst varieer je in je rollen als Business Consultant / Analist, Product Owner, samenvattend; Manager IT Operations met ondersteuning van externe software developers  Een bijdrage leveren in het plezier binnen het (sport)verenigingsleven. Euro-Sportring richt zich tot voetbal- en handbalverenigingen en bijna 135.000 amateur-sporters beleven in teamverband sportieve en sociale hoogtepunten tijdens de toernooien van Euro-Sportring die ‘full serviced’ en meerdaags zijn.       Wat je krijgt op basis van kennis en vaardigheden    Een vast salaris in de bandbreedte van € 6.000 - € 8.000 op basis van fulltime inzet + vakantiegeld en aanvullende pensioenregeling. De voorkeur gaat uit naar een fulltime beschikbare kandidaat.  26 vakantiedagen op basis van fulltime inzet, een goede pensioenregeling.  Eindverantwoordelijkheid over IT binnen een MKB. Lijn-management kan onderdeel worden van je verantwoordelijkheid bij groei binnen het IT team. title: Digital Transformation Manager | Estimating & Pre-Construction
description: Winthrop Technologies is Europe's only dedicated data centre delivery partner, offering full turnkey solutions from design through to construction and commissioning. Headquartered in Dublin, we deliver projects across Europe and have become one of the most trusted names in our sector.     We are currently seeking a  Digital Transformation Manager  to join our Estimating and Pre-Construction team. This position will be based in our  Head Office in Ballymount, Dublin 22 .     This is a key transformation role responsible for identifying, developing and delivering AI and digital initiatives that improve the efficiency, accuracy and consistency of our estimating, tendering and pre-construction processes.     Working closely with Estimating, Pre-Construction, Bid and IT stakeholders, the successful candidate will translate business requirements into practical digital solutions. The role will manage projects from initial discovery and business-case development through to implementation, adoption and continuous improvement.    Requirements    ·        Lead AI and digital transformation projects across Estimating and Pre-Construction.   ·        Review existing processes and identify opportunities for automation and digital improvement.   ·        Manage projects from initial scope and business case through to implementation and adoption.   ·        Work with Estimating, Pre-Construction, Design, Commercial, Planning and IT stakeholders.   ·        Identify practical applications of AI across tendering, cost data, document review, benchmarking and reporting.   ·        Coordinate the selection, testing and implementation of new digital solutions.   ·        Drive process standardisation and continuous improvement.   ·        Manage project plans, risks, stakeholders and delivery milestones.   ·        Monitor adoption and measure the business benefits of implemented solutions.    Qualifications & Skills:    ·        Experience in project management, digital transformation, technology implementation or business change.   ·        Experience within construction, engineering, estimating or pre-construction is highly desirable.   ·        Good understanding of AI, automation, data analytics and digital tools.   ·        Strong commercial and analytical capability.   ·        Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.   ·        Ability to translate business requirements into practical digital solutions.   ·        Experience with tools such as Microsoft 365, Power BI, Power Automate, Copilot, CostX or Buildsoft would be advantageous.    Benefits    ·        Opportunity to work with a market leader in the data centre industry.   ·        Competitive salary package.   ·        Career development and professional growth.   ·        Collaborative working environment.   ·        Strong pipeline of European project growth.       Winthrop Technologies Ltd is an equal opportunities employer

title: Developer Engagement Team  (Contract)
description:
Headquarters:  Remote
 

   Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.   
  At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.     We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.   
  A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.    Roblox is seeking enthusiastic individuals to join our Developer Engagement Team. The ideal candidate will possess a strong focus on understanding issues and critical thinking, alongside the essential qualities required for exceptional customer support. As a contractor of this team, you will play a crucial link between Roblox and its developer community. If you're passionate about the Roblox community and eager to contribute to the success of developers, we'd love to hear from you. 
  You will:  
 
 Assist in resolving creator day-to-day escalations and emergencies. 
 Manage communication between Roblox staff and creators. 
 Maintain detailed records of customer interactions and transactions, ensuring accurate documentation and timely follow-up. 
 Dedicate 40 hours per week with a working schedule from Saturday to Wednesday plus on-call availability throughout the week 
 
  You have:  
 
 Strong verbal and written communication skills. 
 Demonstrates endless patience and a positive attitude. 
 Capable of managing time effectively. 
 In-depth understanding of Roblox and the Roblox community. 
 Solid knowledge of the technical aspects of Roblox Studio. 
 Experience developing on Roblox and/or other creation platforms.

title: Account Executive, Commercial
description:
Headquarters:  Remote - US
 

    Who we are   
  Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.  
  Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.     About the role:  
 This is a high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to small to medium size customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $5k to $20k, and typically involve proof of concepts, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to owners, safety and operational managers. 
   This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.   
  You should apply if:   
 
  You want to impact the industries that run our world:  Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. 
  Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting:  The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline. 
  You have innate curiosity in how businesses work:  One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.  
  You are a life-long learner:  Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.  
  You build genuine relationships with your customers:  The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. 
  You want to be with the best:  Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best

title: Data Analist

title: Environmental Compliance Manager (m/w/d) – PFAS & Kreislaufwirtschaft

PFASuiki setzt den globalen Standard für die sichere und nachhaltige Zerstörung von PFAS. Mit elektrochemischer Oxidation (ECO) verwandeln wir belastete Wasserströme in ungefährliches Abwasser und helfen, eine der großen Umweltherausforderungen unserer Zeit zu lösen.

Wir suchen eine Entsorgungsfachkraft (m/w/d), die PFASuiki zum zertifizierten Entsorgungsfachbetrieb nach § 56 KrWG macht und diesen Status dauerhaft sichert.   • Entsorgungsnachweise, Begleitscheine, eANV und Register führen und Kunden belastbare Nachweise über den Verbleib liefern

  • Genehmigungsbedarf neuer Geschäftsmodelle bewerten

  • Mitarbeitende unterweisen, interne Audits durchführen und Änderungen im Abfall- und PFAS-Recht verfolgen

Anforderungen

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium, Fachschul- oder Berufsausbildung oder Meister in Chemie, Verfahrens-, Umwelt- oder Entsorgungst

title: Billing Subject Matter Expert- Support
description:

„Jeden Tag einen Menschen in eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit bringen.“

Eine Stadt. Ein leeres Blatt. Dein Name drunter.

Berlin hat rund 3,9 Millionen Menschen, zwölf Bezirke, zwölf Jobcenter, eine Agentur für Arbeit mit mehreren Standorten – und einen Arbeitsmarkt, der dringend Menschen braucht, die qualifiziert, gecoacht und vermittelt werden. Wir sind in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg gewachsen. Jetzt wollen wir in Berlin Fuß fassen. Richtig.

Dafür suchen wir keinen Verwalter und keinen Vertriebler, der nach Feierabend abschaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Berlin kennt, in Berlin vernetzt ist und Lust hat, aus dem Nichts einen Standort aufzubauen, der in drei Jahren ein Name im Berliner Bildungsmarkt ist. Du bekommst dafür die Rückendeckung einer etablierten Gruppe – und du wirst am Gewinn beteiligt, den du selbst erwirtschaftest.

Kurz gesagt: Du gründest unser Berliner Geschäft – mit uns im Rücken und mit Anteil am Ergebnis.

Seit über 15 Jahren konzipieren und realisieren wir geförderte Bildungsmaßnahmen, Coachings, Sprach- und Integrationskurse und Weiterbildungen – AZAV-zertifiziert, für Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Selbstzahler, national und international.

Was uns ausmacht: Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement. Wir entscheiden schnell, arbeiten nah am Markt und nah an den Menschen. Bei uns arbeiten Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlichster Herkunft zusammen, wir beraten und unterrichten in mehreren Sprachen. Diversity is für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebter Alltag.

Contexte de la mission

Dans le cadre d'un programme de construction d'une nouvelle usine industrielle à l'international, prévu sur la période 2028-2032, nous recherchons un profil expérimenté pour intervenir en phase amont d'analyse des besoins et de pré-FEED (Front-End Engineering Design).

La mission consiste à réaliser un audit approfondi de deux usines de production existantes, l'une en France et l'autre en Amérique du Nord, afin d'identifier les bonnes pratiques, les axes d'amélioration et les besoins des différents services.

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

description:
📍Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH) | 💰 £75,000

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology.

Our products, Street.co.uk and Spectre form a powerful duo, working harmoniously together to transform an agent's job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK.

How we work in 2026

Engineering at Street Group has changed. Most of us don't write code by hand day-to-day anymore - agents do; we direct. For our mobile team, that shifts where the value is: when AI handles more of the code, what matters most is how the app looks, how it feels, what it does for the user and the ideas you bring to it. Understanding the product and the people using it sits at the heart of the role: we expect engineers to know why they're building something, not just how.

Being genuinely tuned into AI tooling is core to the role here, not a side skill and if you'd rather not work this way, that's fair but we're probably not the place for you. Equally, if you see mobile engineering as getting code onto a screen and calling it "good enough", this probably isn't the role for you either.

We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders.

This role covers the cell side of our protein characterisation work. You would keep the cell lines healthy and run the assays that show how a designed protein behaves on a living cell, week after week, to the same standard.

About us

AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one.

We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team.

The role

You will run cell culture and the cell-based assays for our protein characterisation work. That means the mammalian lines the assays depend on, from thaw through routine passage to a banked and documented stock, and the weekly rhythm of seeding, treating, reading and reporting plates.

Most of it runs in 384-well plates with imaging-based or flow cytometry readouts. You will run those assays as designed, with the controls and replicates that make a curve defensible, and you will be the person who notices when a plate, a line or a reagent lot has started to drift.

title: Member of Scientific Staff, Protein Production
description:

The opportunity

We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders.

This role sits at the start of our protein work. Every measurement we make depends on the protein in the well being the right one, made the same way every time, and you would be one of the people making it.

About us

AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're

building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one.

We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team.

The role

You will make proteins, many of them at once. The work runs from DNA through to purified, quality-checked protein in 96-well format, ready for the binding and biophysical assays downstream of you.

On the DNA side you will prepare expression templates from synthetic gene fragments, by PCR and by Golden Gate or Gibson assembly, and check them before they go forward. You will express proteins in cell-free systems first, with E. coli and mammalian (HEK293) expression following as the menu grows. You will purify them by affinity capture, mostly on magnetic beads in plates, and confirm what you made with quantification, CE-SDS and SEC.

description:

Mines Saint-Étienne, école de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, assure des missions de formation, de recherche, d’innovation et de transfert industriel. Avec 2 500 élèves, 500 personnels et un budget de 50 M€, elle dispose de trois campus spécialisés. Sa stratégie 2023-2027 vise à accompagner les transitions écologique, numérique et générationnelle, tout en contribuant à la souveraineté nationale et européenne en microélectronique et numérique.

Le campus Aix-Marseille-Provence, situé à Gardanne, regroupe le Centre Microélectronique de Provence (CMP), des formations d’ingénieurs et de masters, un incubateur technologique et des plateformes de prototypage. Il accueille environ 400 étudiants et 200 personnels de Mines Saint-Étienne et d’entreprises partenaires.

Le CMP dispose d’une salle blanche de 700 m², équipée d’une centaine d’équipements scientifiques répartis en zones de classes 100, 1 000 et 10 000. Cette plateforme est utilisée par les équipes de recherche, les membres académiques et industriels de l’association Micro-PackS, ainsi que pour les formations initiales et continues.

Ses activités couvrent notamment les procédés de couches minces, la photolithographie, la chimie, la caractérisation physique et électrique des matériaux et dispositifs, le micropackaging, l’électronique imprimée et la préparation d’échantillons.

Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

description:

Designing lifecycle evaluation for nondeterministic domain-specific AI systems.

EggAI Labs

We're opening the EggAI Labs in Tübingen. The Labs purpose is to test new AI capabilities, identify what works, how they'd improve delivery, and then build assets to support teams and clients. EggAI's mission cannot be achieved through one-off client projects alone and the Labs is the way to adapt and scale.

As part of the first cohort, you will join a small peer group and work directly with EggAI's CAIO, a Tübingen alumnus. Your fellow AI Builders will be deliberately chosen to span different passions and strenghts. You will have room to explore and be expected to turn that exploration into something useful. This is not a client-facing role.

The problem: EvalOps

How do we prove an AI system acts as expected under various conditions?

We will explore EvalOps: the methods and tools used to check whether domain-specific AI systems meet their behavioral requirements. Among the key challenges for operating AI systems are nondeterminism, ground-truth curation, evaluation metric-design, latency and costs. EvalOps need to overcome all of them in a disciplined way.

These questions will guide the initial work:

  • Regression suites: How can domain experts turn traces, code, and prompts into useful evals in a way that scales?

description:
Make Your Mark as a Procurement Specialist at Storio group

About the role.

We are looking for a Procurement Specialist at P40 level to take ownership of assigned spend categories across our platform. Storio Group produces millions of personalized photo products every year for customers across 14 European markets. To support this scale, our supply base of materials, packaging, technology, and services requires commercial intelligence, long term thinking, and strong operational rigour.

Reporting to our Procurement Lead, you will operate with significant autonomy to shape sourcing strategies, manage complex supplier relationships, and deliver measurable commercial value. You will act as the internal expert for your spend areas, partnering closely with operations, finance, legal, and business unit leaders to balance cost, quality, and supply security.

description:
Woven by Toyota is enabling Toyota’s once-in-a-century transformation into a mobility company. Inspired by a legacy of innovating for the benefit of others, our mission is to challenge the current state of mobility through human-centric innovation — expanding what “mobility” means and how it serves society.

Our work centers on four pillars: AD/ADAS, our autonomous driving and advanced driver assist technologies; Arene, our software development platform for software-defined vehicles; Woven City, a test course for mobility; and Cloud & AI, the digital infrastructure powering our collaborative foundation. Business-critical functions empower these teams to execute, and together, we’re working toward one bold goal: a world with zero accidents and enhanced well-being for all.

Team

Our data platform team is working on accelerating autonomous driving by providing access to petabytes of data collected by our fleet of autonomous and non-autonomous vehicles. Efficient, fast and cost-effective access to data at large scale is key to tackle the hardest problems in AD/ADAS, from developing the Machine Learning (ML) models for perception and prediction of human driving patterns, to increasing the sophistication of our validation and simulation by identifying rare and interesting real-world driving situations. The data ecosystem developed by the London team is a key building block for developing and testing modern AD/ADAS products that will impact millions of customers. 

Our ML and Data pipelines are built on-top of the open-source Flyte orchestration framework and are deployed to AWS. Pipeline code is written in Python. We use SQS and Kafka to automate data connections and leverage BigQuery and ElasticSearch for data storage. FDSEs deploy ground breaking technical solutions to solve our customers’ hardest problems. Projects often start with a nebulous question like “Why are we losing customers?” or “How can we more effectively identify instances of money laundering?” FDSEs lead the way in developing a solution, from high-level system design and prototyping to application development and data integration. As an FDSE, you leverage everything around you: Palantir products, open source technologies, and anything you and your team can build to drive real impact.
 
You work with customers around the globe, where you gain rare insight into the world’s most important industries and institutions. We help our customers detect insider trading, improve disaster relief, fight healthcare fraud, and more. Each mission presents different challenges, from the regulatory environment to the nature of the data to the user population. You will work to accommodate all aspects of an environment to drive real technical outcomes for our customers.

About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $14M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

As a Software Engineer Intern, Agent, you'll work directly on production AI agents for Sierra's customers. You'll gain hands-on experience contributing to the design and development of AI agents, shipping features, and learning from real-world use cases at scale. If you're hungry to shape and learn from the most important technological wave in history, come build at Sierra.

title: Staff Product Manager, Generative AI Platform
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat. DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt now operate as one global company. Behind the AI experiences millions of people use every day, from shopping assistants to customer support agents, sits one shared Generative AI platform. Our team builds it.

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager in London to own major parts of that platform. Your customers are the engineers and ML researchers across all three brands who build AI products and agents. You'll work with engineering and product leaders in Europe and the US, and your decisions will shape how AI gets built across every market we operate in.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Set the strategy and roadmap for core parts of our GenAI platform: model access and routing, agent infrastructure, and evaluation and observability.
  • Build one platform for three brands. Spot the patterns across Deliveroo, Wolt and DoorDash teams and turn them into shared building blocks, so a capability built once reaches every market.
  • Shape our model portfolio across frontier and open-weight models. Decide where we build, buy or partner in an ecosystem that changes month to month.
  • Make agents production-ready. Give teams safe access to company knowledge, tools and systems, with the quality, latency and cost controls needed to run agents at scale.
  • Own the evaluation strategy so teams can prove quality before launch and keep improving it after.
  • Stay close to your customers.

title: 3D Computer Vision Research Engineer - World Map
description:
About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About the Role

You'll help build the geometric foundation of the next-generation world map — joining our World Map Research Engineering team (Geospatial Alignment) as a Research Engineer or Senior Research Engineer. This is an end-to-end applied research role that spans from strong engineering and data-systems work to R&D in 3D deep learning, transformers, and foundation models. You'll develop new algorithms, produce the research data and evaluation assets needed to advance them, and engineer the resulting capabilities into dependable production systems.

The World

title: Member of Scientific Staff, Cell Culture and Functional Assays
description:
LOCATION: King's Cross, London · PATTERN: Lab-based, full-time

The opportunity

We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders.

This role covers the cell side of our protein characterisation work. You would keep the cell lines healthy and run the assays that show how a designed protein behaves on a living cell, week after week, to the same standard.

About us

AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one.

We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team.

The role

You will run cell culture and the cell-based assays for our protein characterisation work. That means the mammalian lines the assays depend on, from thaw through routine passage to a banked and documented stock, and the weekly rhythm of seeding, treating, reading and reporting plates.

Most of it runs in 384-well plates with imaging-based or flow cytometry readouts. You will run those assays as designed, with the controls and replicates that make a curve defensible, and you will be the person who notices when a plate, a line or a reagent lot has started to drift.
